item.title: ニデック、電子部品子会社を米カーライルＧに売却 1029億円
item.description: [東京 １日 ロイター] - ニデックは１日、 電子部品子会社のニデックコンポーネンツ（旧コパル電子）を米投資...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ニデック、電子部品子会社を米カーライルＧに売却　1029億円 15:54 配信

ニデックのロゴ。都内で９月撮影。REUTERS/Manami Yamada

[東京 １日 ロイター] - ニデックは１日、 電子部品子会社のニデックコンポーネンツ（旧コパル電子）を米投資ファンドのカーライルグループに１０２９億円で売却すると発表した。１２月１日付で譲渡する。

今回の売却が連結業績に与える影響は現在精査中で、今後公表すべき事項が発生した場合は速やかに開示するとした。

item.title: UK annual house price growth weakest since December 2025 after surprise September drop
item.description: British annual house prices rose at their weakest annual pace since December 2025 last month and unexpectedly fell 0.2% on the month, in a sign that higher borrowing costs caused by the war in Iran hurt demand.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British annual house prices rose at their weakest annual pace since December 2025 last month and unexpectedly fell 0.2% on the month, in a sign that higher borrowing costs caused by the war in Iran hurt demand. Prices rose by 0.8% in September compared with the same month last year, mortgage lender Nationwide Building Society said on Thursday, the weakest annual growth since December 2025 and halving from August's 1.6% increase. The rise was below the 1.3% annual increase which was forecast in a Reuters poll of economists. In monthly terms, prices dropped at the joint-fastest pace since May, and below the zero growth forecast in the poll. "Market activity and house prices have remained subdued in recent months, in part reflecting the uncertain economic backdrop," said Robert Gardner, Nationwide's chief economist. "Geopolitical tensions remain high, with the conflict in the Middle East exerting upward pressure on energy prices, fanning inflation concerns." He said while there were signs that higher energy prices were not feeding through to underlying price pressures, investor expectations that the Bank of England will raise borrowing costs have kept upward pressure on mortgage rates. Financial markets expect the BoE to increase the benchmark Bank Rate by a quarter-point in November and another move is priced in for February. Prime Minister Andy Burnham has announced a [USN:L4N45K0Y6 TEXT:"new loan program to help first time buyers"] get on the property ladder. It will be open to homebuyers with a 2.5% deposit and provide loans of up to 20% of a property's value, the government said on Saturday, with further details to be confirmed in finance minister John Healey's budget later this month.

item.title: スイス氷河、今年は5％超消失 記録的熱波で極端な融解常態化
item.description:
Cecile Mantovani Denis Balibouse
[レディアブルレ（スイス） １日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Cecile Mantovani　Denis Balibouse

[レディアブルレ（スイス） １日 ロイター] - 欧州を襲った記録的な熱波の中で、スイスの氷河では氷の消失が急速に進んでおり、今年は過去最悪級の消失を記録した。

スイス氷河モニタリング・ネットワーク（ＧＬＡＭＯＳ）とスイス科学アカデミー（ＳＣＮＡＴ）傘下の氷圏観測委員会（ＳＣＣ）が１日公表した報告書によると、国内の氷河は２０２６年に氷の５％超を失った。極端な融解が起きる年が常態化し、氷河の後退が加速していることが浮き彫りになった。

スイスの氷河は過去５年間で２割近くが失われ、将来の水供給が脅かされるとともに、欧州の氷原が長期的に存続できるか疑問が生じているという。

ＧＬＡＭＯＳのマティアス・フス代表は、冬の降雪不足と夏の記録的な高温が重なり、今年は「膨大な」融解が起きたと指摘。「今や極端な融解がほぼ毎年起きており、極めて憂慮すべき状況だ」と述べた。

スイス最大のアレッチ氷河では今年、融解量が過去最大となったほか、ツァンフルーロン氷河では平均の厚さが４メートル超減少。フス氏は、数年前には考えられなかった事態だと述べた。

推計によると、スイスの氷河は７─９月だけで計約２兆２０００億リットルの水を喪失。これはスイスの家庭が年間に消費する飲料水の４倍超に相当する。

氷河融解は夏季の水不足緩和に寄与する一面もあるが、フス氏は氷河が縮小するにつれ、この恩恵は薄れていると述べた。

item.title: India's RBI FX swaps create opening for firms to tap dollar funding at lower cost
item.description: Billions of dollars of FX swaps by the central bank have shifted the economics of cross-currency funding for Indian companies, creating an opportunity to access dollar funding at a relatively lower cost.
item.dc:creator: Nimesh Vora
item.content:encoded: Billions of dollars of FX swaps by the central bank have shifted the economics of cross-currency funding for Indian companies, creating an opportunity to access dollar funding at a relatively lower cost. The Reserve Bank of India has [USN:L4N45K0JK TEXT:"been draining surplus liquidity"] in India's banking system through dollar-rupee swaps that have spurred a jump in FX forward premiums. Higher forward premiums make currency swaps a more attractive route to raise dollar funds by lowering their effective cost. Surging US Treasury yields, underpinned by inflation pressures, oil prices and resilient economic activity along with expectations of more Federal Reserve rate hikes this year are all making it more expensive for Indian firms to borrow in dollars directly. In this environment (of higher US yields and FX premiums), borrowing in rupees and using the forward market to convert the liability into dollars would "result in a lower all-in US dollar funding cost" than direct overseas borrowing, said Sameer Karyatt, managing director and head of trading at DBS Bank India. "The extent of the cost advantage would depend on the customer’s credit rating and the relative borrowing spreads available in the domestic and overseas markets." RBI rules allow Indian companies that meet minimum net worth and adequate risk management eligibility requirements that have rupee liabilities to use currency swaps to transform those liabilities into foreign-currency exposure. Rupee-dollar swap pricing has jumped across tenors, with implied rates for two-, three-, and five-year swaps rising 90 to 110 basis points. BANKS MAKE A PITCH Banks are approaching corporate borrowers with structures in which a rupee loan, commercial paper or non-convertible debenture is combined with a dollar-rupee cross-currency swap. In two recent structures seen by Reuters, companies could convert rupee borrowing into dollar funding at rates below the prevailing US dollar funding rate, with the discount varying by tenor. Corporate borrowers are typically looking for up to three-year tenors, while asset-liability desks at banks are considering longer-dated structures to raise dollar funding for overseas and GIFT City branches, a senior treasury official at a foreign lender said, requesting anonymity because he was not authorised to speak to the media.

item.title: 米上院、エネ・インフラ許認可改革で超党派合意 承認迅速化へ
item.description:
Timothy Gardner Nichola Groom
[ワシントン ３０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Timothy Gardner　Nichola Groom

[ワシントン ３０日 ロイター] - 米上院の超党派議員は３０日、大規模なエネルギー・インフラ事業の許認可制度を改革する法案で合意したと発表した。ただ採決は中間選挙後となる。

今回の合意は、議会が長年取り組んできた連邦政府の許認可制度改革にとって重要な節目となる。議員や業界団体は送電線やデータセンター、鉱山のほか、再生可能エネルギーと化石燃料の事業の建設工事を加速するため、制度改革が必要だと訴えている。

環境団体は環境保護措置を弱めるものだとして法案を批判した。一方、再生可能エネルギー開発業者や石油・ガス生産業者などの団体は、インフラ整備を加速させると評価した。

ホワイトハウス当局者は、コスト削減と雇用創出につながるとして、トランプ政権が法案を支持していると述べた。

３０日に公表された条文によると、法案は環境審査に期限を設け、訴訟による異議申し立てを制限し、一度交付した許認可を取り消しにくくすることで、連邦政府の承認手続きを迅速化する。関係機関に主要な審査を１─２年以内に終えるよう義務付け、省庁間の調整も効率化する。

法案は電力網の整備にも重点を置き、送電線の建設・改良を承認するための新たな手続きを設ける。再生可能エネルギー事業を加速する規定も盛り込み、陸上・洋上両方の風力発電を対象にすると明記している。

連邦政府機関が特定の技術について、許認可を不当に遅らせたり拒否したりする行為を繰り返すことを防ぐ条項も設けた。

item.title: POINT MARCHÉS Baisse en vue en Europe avant les chiffres de l'inflation (actualisé)
item.description: Les principales Bourses européennes sont attendues en baisse jeudi pour la première séance du mois et du dernier trimestre de l'année sur fond de crainte inflationniste persistante après un mois de septembre marqué par une flambée des taux obligataires et des cours du pétrole.
item.dc:creator: Claude Chendjou
item.content:encoded: Les principales Bourses européennes sont attendues en baisse jeudi pour la première séance du mois et du dernier trimestre de l'année sur fond de crainte inflationniste persistante après un mois de septembre marqué par une flambée des taux obligataires et des cours du pétrole. D'après les premières indications disponibles, le CAC 40 parisien (.FCHI) devrait perdre 0,53% à l'ouverture. Le Dax (.GDAXI) à Francfort pourrait reculer de 0,51%, tandis que le FTSE 100 (.FTSE) à Londres devrait abandonner 0,79%. L'indice EuroStoxx 50 (.STOXX50E) est attendu en repli de 0,46% et le Stoxx 600 (.STOXX) en baisse de 0,55%. Les investisseurs attendent fébrilement vendredi la publication des chiffres de l'inflation en zone euro alors que les premières données en la matière dans plusieurs pays du bloc monétaire ont montré mercredi une accélération de la hausse des prix. La publication ce jeudi des indices définitifs donnera un aperçu des pressions inflationnistes sur l'activité des entreprises du secteur manufacturier alors que la version "[USN:ZRN00EKPS TEXT:"flash"]" de l'indice avait montré le mois dernier une stabilité à 52,7, comme en août. L'indice ISM manufacturier pour le mois de septembre est également attendu aux Etats-Unis alors que l'inflation PCE, pour le mois d'août, a offert un peu de soutien mercredi aux actions, en ressortant en dessous des attentes, à 3,4% sur un an. Il reste cependant à un niveau élevé, la Réserve fédérale américaine (Fed) ayant pour objectif une inflation à 2%. Selon les données compilées par LSEG, les traders estiment désormais à environ 37% la probabilité d'un relèvement des taux de la Fed en octobre, contre une probabilité d'environ 45% avant la publication des données sur le PCE. Il faudra sans doute attendre la publication vendredi du rapport mensuel sur l'emploi aux Etats-Unis pour le mois de septembre pour conforter les anticipations sur l'évolution des taux directeurs, même si les chiffres des inscriptions hebdomadaires au chômage pourraient donner une tendance, après l'enquête le rapport [USN:L8N45K0RB TEXT:"Jolts"] et l'enquête [USN:ZON00GKH8 TEXT:"ADP"], publiés dans la semaine. A WALL STREET La Bourse de New York a fini en ordre dispersé mercredi, seul le Nasdaq ayant terminé en hausse, alors que des données moins élevées qu'attendu sur l'inflation aux Etats-Unis ont éloigné un peu aux yeux des investisseurs le spectre d'une nouvelle hausse des taux de la Fed dès octobre. L'indice Dow Jones (.DJI) a cédé 0,86%, ou 443,87 points, à 50.906,05 points. Le S&P-500 (.SPX) , plus large, a perdu 19,30 points, soit 0,25%, à 7.651,54 points. Le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) a avancé de son côté de 63,52 points (0,24%) à 26.861,06 points. EN ASIE A la Bourse de Tokyo, l'indice Nikkei (.N225) a avancé de 3,3% à 68.956,72 points, à un pic de six semaines, soutenu par les prévisions de Micron qui ont fait grimper les cours des valeurs liées aux semi-conducteurs. Le Topix (.TOPX) , plus large, a pris 0,57% à 4.131,98 points. Micron (MU.O) a annoncé mercredi des prévisions de revenus trimestriels supérieures aux attentes et a indiqué que ses clients avaient augmenté leurs engagements, dans le cadre de ses accords d'approvisionnement à long terme, à 32 milliards de dollars, ce qui témoigne d'une demande soutenue pour les puces mémoire destinées à l'IA. Dans le sillage de Micron, le fabricant japonais d'équipements de test de puces Advantest (6857.T) a bondi de 9,14%, son compatriote spécialisé dans la fabrication de composants électroniques Murata Manufacturing (6981.T) a grimpé de 8,28%, tandis que le fabricant de puces mémoire Kioxia (285A.T) s'est adjugé 5,42%. "Les résultats de Micron constituent une nouvelle confirmation solide de la demande en matière d'IA et de mémoire, mais les marchés pourraient de plus en plus se demander si nous ne nous rapprochons pas du pic de la pénurie de mémoire, même si la demande continue de dépasser l'offre", a commenté Charu Chanana, cheffe stratège en investissements chez Saxo. "Le contexte macroéconomique devient également plus mitigé. La faiblisse des données américaines a quelque peu allégé la pression sur les anticipations concernant la Fed et les taux à court terme, mais les taux à long terme restent élevés; les inquiétudes liées au coût du capital n'ont donc pas vraiment disparu", a-t-elle ajouté. Le Kospi sud-coréen (.KS11) a effacé ses pertes initiales et gagne désormais 1,80%, tandis que l'indice boursier de référence à Taïwan (.TWII) avance de 0,86%. Les marchés chinois sont fermés ce jeudi pour un jour férié. LES VALEURS A SUIVRE EN EUROPE: [USN:L8N45M1OR] CHANGES Le dollar avance de 0,13% face à un panier de devises de référence (.DXY) , se rapprochant de son pic de deux mois, soutenu par des rendements élevés des bons du Trésor américain, en partie due aux inquiétudes concernant les pressions persistantes sur les prix mondiaux découlant de la guerre au Moyen-Orient. Le billet vert a gagné 2% sur l'ensemble du mois de septembre. L'euro se déprécie de 0,06%, à 1,1321 dollar. La monnaie unique européenne a enregistré une perte de près de 2,5% en septembre, sa plus forte baisse depuis juillet 2025, sous la pression des inquiétudes liées à la dette et à l'énergie en Europe. La livre sterling s'échange à 1,3253 dollar (-0,09%), après avoir reculé de 2,1% le mois dernier, pénalisée elle aussi par le renforcement du dollar. Le yen cède jeudi 0,53% à 158,22 pour un dollar mais a enregistré un gain de près de 1,5% sur le mois de septembre. "Le yen a été la devise la plus forte du G10 (en septembre), et la réticence du marché à être pris au dépourvu par une intervention a clairement un impact", note Kit Juckes, chef stratège changes chez Société Générale. Les "minutes" de la réunion de septembre de la Banque du Japon (BoJ), publiées jeudi, montrent que l'institution a débattu de la nécessité de nouvelles hausses de taux directeurs, ce qui soutient les anticipations d'un resserrement monétaire supplémentaire. TAUX Le rendement des bons du Trésor américain à dix ans est pratiquement stable, à 5,2829%, après avoir grimpé en séance à 5,306%, son niveau le plus haut depuis la mi-juin 2007. Le rendement à 30 ans ressort à 5,663% après avoir atteint 5,6517% la veille, son plus haut niveau depuis juin 2002. L'attention du marché se portée sur la durée pendant laquelle les rendements des bons du Trésor américain resteront au-dessus du seuil psychologique des 5%. "Aux Etats-Unis, la dette a dépassé les 40.000 milliards de dollars et la situation budgétaire ne montre aucun signe d’amélioration. Ainsi, le seuil des 5% à lui seul, en termes absolus, ne veut pas dire grand-chose, surtout si on le replace dans son contexte historique", commente Darren Shames, responsable taux chez Nomura. "Mais je pense que c'est la trajectoire de l'évolution des taux, leur vitesse, qui retient véritablement l'attention des investisseurs", a-t-il ajouté. En zone euro, le rendement du Bund allemand à dix ans grappille 1,1 point de base, à 3,5904% après une baisse de 3,4 points de base la veille. L'écart de taux entre les obligations allemandes et françaises de même échéance se stabilise autour de 126 points de base alors que le gouvernement français doit présenter en Conseil des ministres une première copie de son budget pour 2027. PÉTROLE Le marché pétrolier est en repli jeudi. La reprise des exportations de brut du Golfe et la hausse inattendue des stocks américains la semaine dernière atténuent les inquiétudes concernant l'approvisionnement, tandis que les investisseurs étudient les initiatives diplomatiques entre les Etats-Unis et l'Iran pour mettre fin à leur conflit. Le Brent reflue de 0,56% à 97,48 dollars le baril et le brut léger américain (West Texas Intermediate, WTI) décline de 0,92% à 89,58 dollars . Les deux références ont progressé d'environ un dollar le baril mercredi. Le Brent a enregistré une hausse mensuelle d'environ 14% en septembre, sa plus forte progression depuis juillet, tandis que le WTI a augmenté d'environ 5% sur le mois. PRINCIPAUX INDICATEURS ÉCONOMIQUES À L'AGENDA DU 1ER OCTOBRE: PAYS GMT INDICATEUR PÉRIODE CONSENSUS PRÉCÉDENT FR 07h50 Indice PMI manufacturier (final) septembre 50,3 50,3* DE 07h55 Indice PMI manufacturier (final) septembre 53,8 53,8* EZ 08h00 Indice PMI manufacturier (final) septembre 52,7 52,7* GB 08h30 Indice PMI manufacturier (final) septembre 52,0 52,0* EZ 09h00 Taux de chômage août 6,4% 6,4% USA 12h30 Inscriptions hebdo au chômage sem. au 26 septembre 200.000 197.000 USA 14h00 Indice ISM manufacturier septembre 55,0 54,6 *première estimation

item.title: Vietnam to move all Hanoi-listed stocks to Ho Chi Minh index in December under market overhaul
item.description: Vietnam will move all its listed stocks to the main Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange in late December, completing a long-planned market restructuring and ending equity trading on the Hanoi Stock Exchange .
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Vietnam will move all its listed stocks to the main Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange (.VNI) in late December, completing a long-planned market restructuring and ending equity trading on the Hanoi Stock Exchange (.HNXI) . The announcement, made late on Wednesday, follows Vietnam's upgrade by [USN:L6N45A0NP TEXT:"FTSE Russell"] to secondary emerging market status and comes as the government pushes further reforms to attract foreign capital and support a longer-term ambition of securing a similar upgrade from MSCI. The Vietnam Exchange, the state-owned holding company that owns both bourses, said the final trading day for Hanoi-listed stocks would be December 23, after which those would be suspended for two days to facilitate the transfer. From December 28, all listed stocks in Vietnam will be traded on the Ho Chi Minh index. The Hanoi bourse will continue to operate other securities markets under current regulations, including for bonds, derivatives and other financial instruments, according to the notice. The transfer will affect a small portion of the market, with the Hanoi market's capitalisation at 462.8 trillion dong ($17.82 billion), or about 5.4% of the Ho Chi Minh index's 8,549 trillion dong ($329.23 billion), according to LSEG data as of October 1. The move marks the final stage of a restructuring plan for Vietnam's securities markets under finance ministry regulations that redefined the roles of the exchanges. In morning trade on Thursday, the benchmark VN Index fell 0.59% and the HNX Index declined 0.71%. ($1 = 25,967.0000 dong)

item.title: フィリピン、中国調査船に巡視船派遣 海警局船と対峙
item.description:
[マニラ １日 ロイター] - フィリピン沿岸警備隊は１日、北部バタネス州沖の台湾に近い海域で活動していた中国の海洋調査船に対し、最大級の巡視船と航空機を派遣して対応し、同海域から退去させたと発表した。その際、中国海警局の船が現れ、調査船を防衛しようとしたという。
沿岸警備隊の報道官は、フィリピン側の対応によって「調査船による無許可の海洋科学調査を阻止し、停泊海域から退去させた」と述べた。
沿岸警備隊の発表内容は以下の通り。
• 中国の調査船は９月２８日以降、イトバヤット島の北西約３７カイリ（約６９キロ）にとどまっていた。沿岸警備隊は、全長９７メートルの巡視船「テレサ・マグバヌア」と航空機１機を派遣した。
• この調査船「ＪＩＡ ＨＡＩ ＫＥ ７」について、フィリピン沿岸警備隊は先に、位置情報を偽装していたと指摘していた。
•
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[マニラ １日 ロイター] - フィリピン沿岸警備隊は１日、北部バタネス州沖の台湾に近い海域で活動していた中国の海洋調査船に対し、最大級の巡視船と航空機を派遣して対応し、同海域から退去させたと発表した。その際、中国海警局の船が現れ、調査船を防衛しようとしたという。

沿岸警備隊の報道官は、フィリピン側の対応によって「調査船による無許可の海洋科学調査を阻止し、停泊海域から退去させた」と述べた。

沿岸警備隊の発表内容は以下の通り。

• 中国の調査船は９月２８日以降、イトバヤット島の北西約３７カイリ（約６９キロ）にとどまっていた。沿岸警備隊は、全長９７メートルの巡視船「テレサ・マグバヌア」と航空機１機を派遣した。

• この調査船「ＪＩＡ　ＨＡＩ　ＫＥ　７」について、フィリピン沿岸警備隊は先に、位置情報を偽装していたと指摘していた。

• テレサ・マグバヌアは中国調査船まで１００ヤード（約９１メートル）以内まで接近し、複合艇を展開。隊員が無線で警告を発する中、複合艇が船の周りを数回旋回した。

• 調査船は、フィリピン軍の作戦中、同軍艦艇を回避しようとした。

• その後、中国海警局の船が到着して調査船を守ろうとし、フィリピン軍に対して無線で警告を発した。

• 沿岸警備隊は、調査船が民間所有の船であることから海警船の関与は「重大」と指摘。中国政府との関係や、バタネス州沖およびルソン海峡の海底ケーブル敷設海域付近で収集した可能性があるデータの目的について疑問を投げかけるとした。

• 調査船を停泊海域から退去させたものの、フィリピンの排他的経済水域（ＥＥＺ）から確実に離れるよう、テレサ・マグバヌアが監視を続けている。

item.title: Greer exhorte le G20 à soutenir la politique douanière de Trump
item.description: Le représentant américain au Commerce, Jamieson Greer, a appelé mercredi les économies du G20 à s'abstenir de toute mesure coercitive en matière de commerce alimentaire, à s'attaquer à la surcapacité industrielle et à réexaminer le système de tarifs douaniers en vigueur depuis la Seconde Guerre mondiale.
item.dc:creator: David Lawder
item.content:encoded: Le représentant américain au Commerce, Jamieson Greer, a appelé mercredi les économies du G20 à s'abstenir de toute mesure coercitive en matière de commerce alimentaire, à s'attaquer à la surcapacité industrielle et à réexaminer le système de tarifs douaniers en vigueur depuis la Seconde Guerre mondiale. Dans son discours d'ouverture de la réunion des ministres du Commerce du G20, Jamieson Greer a exposé les objectifs de l'administration Trump, qui visent à relancer l'industrie manufacturière américaine par le biais de droits de douane, d'accords commerciaux et de mesures destinées à sécuriser les chaînes d'approvisionnement essentielles. L'ordre du jour de cette réunion, organisée sous l'égide des Etats-Unis, s'inscrit dans la lignée de la stratégie de l'administration américaine, qui consiste à utiliser cette tribune pour mettre l'accent sur les subventions industrielles chinoises, les surcapacités et les politiques économiques non conformes aux principes du marché. Lors d'une réunion des ministres des Finances du G20 qui s'est tenue au début du mois de septembre à Asheville, en Caroline du Nord, tous les pays membres, à l'exception de la Chine, sont convenus de prendre des mesures contre les politiques économiques "non conformes aux principes du marché" et les distorsions commerciales qui entraînent une dépendance excessive vis-à-vis des exportations. La Chine a rejeté les allégations selon lesquelles ses politiques industrielles auraient créé des surcapacités, et accuse les pays occidentaux d'utiliser cette question pour justifier des mesures protectionnistes. "Lorsque des politiques et des pratiques non conformes aux principes du marché permettent à la production de dépasser largement la demande intérieure, les conséquences se répercutent au-delà des frontières", a déclaré mercredi Jamieson Greer. "La surproduction envahit les marchés mondiaux, exerçant une pression sur les producteurs et les travailleurs ailleurs." Jamieson Greer a également critiqué la clause de la "nation la plus favorisée" (dite clause "NPF"), pierre angulaire de l'Organisation mondiale du commerce (OMC), qui sous-tend un système commercial mondial fondé sur l'égalité de traitement entre les membres. Au cours des deux mandats de Donald Trump à la présidence des Etats-Unis, l'administration américaine a affaibli cette clause en imposant des droits de douane spécifiques contre de nombreux pays. "La clause de la nation la plus favorisée, en particulier lorsqu'elle est appliquée sans condition, limite la capacité des économies à réagir efficacement aux politiques génératrices de distorsions et à s'adapter à l'évolution des conditions du marché", a dit Jamieson Greer. Il a ajouté que les mesures prises par certains pays pour restreindre les exportations de denrées alimentaires, d'intrants agricoles et d'autres produits agricoles entraînent de "graves conséquences" pour les économies du monde entier. Jamieson Greer a également cherché à justifier les droits de douane imposés par les Etats-Unis à 59 pays et à l'Union européenne (UE) en raison d'allégations de laxisme dans la lutte contre le travail forcé, affirmant que cela conférait un avantage artificiel en matière de prix et sapait la confiance dans le système commercial mondial.

item.title: 約200年ぶり女性への死刑執行が失敗、米テネシー州
item.description:
Steve Gorman
[３０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Steve Gorman

[３０日 ロイター] - 米テネシー州の刑務所当局は３０日、３１年前に同級生を殺害した罪で死刑判決を受けたクリスタ・パイク死刑囚（５０）に薬物注射による刑執行を試みたが死に至らなかったため、医療施設に搬送されたと明らかにした。同州では約２００年ぶりとなる女性への死刑執行だった。

搬送後の容体や、今後の法的対応は明らかになっていない。

パイク死刑囚は１９９５年、同州ノックスビルでコリーン・スレマーさん（１９）を拷問、殴打して死亡させた事件に関与していた。犯行当時は１８歳だった。

ＮＢＣニュースによると、弁護団は立会人の証言として「執行担当者は致死薬の入った注射器２本分を全て投与したが、パイク死刑囚はなお生存し、いびきをかいている」と訴え、執行中止を申し立てた。立ち会った記者らは、同死刑囚があえぎ、痛みを訴え、脚を繰り返し蹴り上げていたと証言した。

州矯正局は、承認された執行手順を全て順守し、それ以上の措置は認められていないと説明した。

人権専門家らはパイク死刑囚の犯行時の年齢や幼少期に性的虐待を受けた経緯、未治療の精神疾患を理由に刑執行に反対していた。

item.title: JERA teams up with Dell, RHAELM on AI infrastructure development in Japan
item.description: Japan's biggest power generator JERA will partner with Dell Technologies and UK-based AI infrastructure developer RHAELM to accelerate the development of AI infrastructure in Japan, the three companies said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Japan's biggest power generator JERA will partner with Dell Technologies (DELL.N) and UK-based AI infrastructure developer RHAELM to accelerate the development of AI infrastructure in Japan, the three companies said on Thursday. They signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to develop a standardised framework for building AI infrastructure at a national scale in Japan, starting with a $15 billion hyperscale data centre in Chiba. The model will be applied first to a project in Chiba, where Apollo Global Management plans to serve as a strategic investment and financial partner for RHAELM, they said in a statement. The companies aim to create a standardised, repeatable and scalable model from the outset, reducing the lengthy lead times and complexity involved in developing each project independently. They aim to establish the model first in Japan and explore opportunities to apply it in other global markets. In Chiba, JERA will make available land adjacent to its Chiba power station, while RHAELM will develop, construct, operate and finance a 400-megawatt-class hyperscale AI data centre. The companies aim to begin operating the new data centre in phases in 2028 and reach the full 400 MW capacity in 2029, a JERA official said. JERA will supply 400 MW of power capacity under a 15- to 25-year agreement, while Dell will provide standardised, rack-scale AI infrastructure.

item.title: Klopp reluctant to weigh in on City fallout out of respect for Guardiola
item.description: Former Liverpool manager Jurgen Klopp said his respect for Pep Guardiola and the Manchester City sides that battled Liverpool in some of the Premier League's closest title races has left him reluctant to comment on the fallout from City's financial rules case.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Former Liverpool manager Jurgen Klopp said his respect for Pep Guardiola and the Manchester City sides that battled Liverpool in some of the Premier League's closest title races has left him reluctant to comment on the fallout from City's financial rules case. City were found [USN:L6N45L10S TEXT:"guilty of serious financial breaches"] by an independent commission on Tuesday, though the club have [USN:L8N45M29U TEXT:"denied wrongdoing"] and are expected to appeal, with sanctions yet to be determined. The 59-year-old, whose Liverpool side twice finished a point behind City, had previously joked that he would attend a parade if Liverpool were retrospectively awarded titles but said he no longer felt that way. "I haven't given it much thought, even though I've seen it of course," Klopp told reporters on Wednesday. "I also know what I said about it in the past and how if there's ever a parade I'll be there, but it doesn't feel like that anymore. "My respect for Pep Guardiola and the football played at City during the time we played against each other... plus what an opponent they proved to be for us at the very highest level is far too great for me to be able to say anything now." Klopp, who led Liverpool to the Premier League and Champions League titles during his nine-year spell at Anfield before [USN:L8N3HM0L0 TEXT:"departing in 2024"], said he remained comfortable with the club's achievements regardless of any future developments in the City case. The German added that he would rather allow the process to run its course than speculate about the potential consequences for City.

item.title: Mientras España suspende los desahucios, Portugal aprueba un proyecto de ley para acelerarlos
item.description: El Parlamento portugués aprobó el miércoles en primera lectura una polémica reforma del mercado del alquiler destinada a agilizar los desahucios y poner fin a los controles del alquiler en los nuevos contratos, en lo que el Gobierno de centroderecha espera que anime a los propietarios a sacar más viviendas al mercado.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Parlamento portugués aprobó el miércoles en primera lectura una polémica reforma del mercado del alquiler destinada a agilizar los desahucios y poner fin a los controles del alquiler en los nuevos contratos, en lo que el Gobierno de centroderecha espera que anime a los propietarios a sacar más viviendas al mercado. La reforma, criticada por las asociaciones de inquilinos como "una barbaridad", contrasta fuertemente con lo que está ocurriendo en la vecina España, donde el Gobierno de izquierdas decretó el martes la prohibición de los desahucios de inquilinos vulnerables hasta 2030, junto con otras medidas, en un clima de protestas contra los desahucios y el aumento de los alquileres. Las líneas generales de la reforma se aprobaron después de que el partido de extrema derecha Chega se abstuviera de forma inesperada, tras haber expresado sus objeciones durante el debate, mientras que todos los partidos de izquierda votaron en contra. Portugal se enfrenta a una de las peores crisis de vivienda de Europa, con alquileres para nuevos contratos que casi se han duplicado desde 2017 y que se han vuelto inasequibles para muchos hogares. El Gobierno afirma que más de 250.000 viviendas permanecen vacías porque la incertidumbre jurídica disuade a los propietarios de alquilarlas, pero las asociaciones de inquilinos sostienen que la reforma no haría más que agravar la crisis. "Esta propuesta de reforma es una auténtica barbaridad", dijo a Reuters António Machado, presidente de la Asociación de Inquilinos de Lisboa, quien dijo que la reforma "desequilibraría aún más el mercado del alquiler a favor de los propietarios" y solo conduciría a un aumento de los alquileres, en lugar de aliviar la crisis de la asequibilidad de la vivienda. También tachó de "puro oportunismo" los planes del Gobierno de acelerar los desahucios, argumentando que los casos de inquilinos que no pagan el alquiler son insignificantes. Chega ha manifestado su intención de modificar algunas disposiciones antes de la votación final, ya que, según afirma, estas generarían incertidumbre tanto para los inquilinos como para los propietarios, y ha pedido "una solución más equilibrada". Este país, con una población de unos 11 millones de habitantes, cuenta con alrededor de un millón de viviendas de alquiler, de las cuales más del 23% tienen contratos de más de 20 años de antigüedad. La reforma aceleraría los desahucios al reducir el umbral de atrasos en el pago del alquiler de tres a dos meses y permitiría a los propietarios desalojar a los inquilinos que paguen repetidamente el alquiler con más de ocho días de retraso. Además, pondría fin al límite del 2% en los aumentos de alquiler este año para las viviendas alquiladas en los últimos cinco años.

item.title: 午後3時のドルは158円前半へ上昇、日銀連続利上げ観測後退で
item.description:
Hiroko Hamada
[東京 １日 ロイター] -
ドル...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
午後3時のドルは158円前半へ上昇、日銀連続利上げ観測後退で 15:26 配信

米ドル紙幣。２０１６年１１月撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Hiroko Hamada

[東京 １日 ロイター] -

ドル／円 ユーロ／ドル ユーロ／円

午後３時現在 158.38／158.39 1.1317／1.1319 179.25／179.26

午前９時現在 157.55／157.58 1.1326／1.1328 178.47／178.48

ＮＹ午後５時 157.39／157.44 1.1328／1.1332 178.32／178.36

午後３時のドルは、前日のニューヨーク市場終盤に比べてドル高／円安の１５８円前半で推移している。朝方公表された９月日銀短観や９月開催分日銀会合の主な意見を受けて、連続利上げ観測が後退し、ドル買い・円売りが進行。ドルは１円近く上昇し、約１週間ぶりの高値を付けた。

朝方、１５７円前半で推移していたドルはじりじりと上昇。９月日銀短観では、大企業・製造業の業況判断指数（ＤＩ）がプラス２４と６期連続で改善、大企業・非製造業はプラス３５と５期ぶりに悪化した。

一方、９月の日銀会合では、先行きも短いスパンでの利上げが必要だとする意見が複数出されていたことが明らかになった。

野村証券のアナリスト・後藤祐二朗氏は「短観では、設備投資計画が下方修正されたほか、企業の物価見通しはほぼ横ばいとなっていた。主な意見では、注目されていた内閣府出席者のコメントが、前のめりすぎる利上げに対しては釘をさすような内容だった」と指摘する。一段と利上げを急がなければならない内容ではなかったとして、連続利上げ観測が後退し、ドル買い・円売りが進行した。

午後の取引でもドルの底堅い地合いは続き、一時１５８．４０円付近まで上昇。もっとも、２００日線が位置する１５８円半ば付近では、「当局による口先介入も入るのではないか」（国内金融機関・シニアアナリスト）との声も聞かれた。

野村証券の後藤氏は「１６０円に近づくと一段と介入警戒が高まるとみられ、ここからどんどん円安方向に振れる展開にはなりにくいのではないか」と話した。

item.title: Bonds teeter after US Treasuries' worst quarter since 1994
item.description: US yields hit two-decade highs for a seventh straight session on Thursday before a drop in oil prices steadied a bond market reeling from its worst quarter this century, as investors brace for higher interest rates.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US yields hit two-decade highs for a seventh straight session on Thursday before a drop in oil prices steadied a bond market reeling from its worst quarter this century, as investors brace for higher interest rates. The benchmark US 10-year Treasury racked up an 87.1 basis point rise in yield over the September quarter, the sharpest quarterly rise since 1994, according to LSEG data. A yardstick for borrowing costs and asset prices globally, the 10-year Treasury yield touched 5.31% on Thursday, the highest since 2007, before steadying just below 5.28%. The 30-year Treasury yield topped 5.65%, its highest since 2002. In [USN:L1N45M03S TEXT:"Japan"], where inflation is finally taking hold after a decades-long battle with deflation, sovereign yields notched an unprecedented fifth consecutive quarter of double-digit gains. Yields rise when bond prices fall. Yields have surged around the world as soaring energy costs fan inflation and as the boom in AI and data centre building lifts expectations for growth and for where short-term interest rates will settle. [USN:L1N45K0MU TEXT:"Higher rates matter"] because they raise financing costs for companies and mortgage borrowers and leave governments spending more on interest payments, with less left over for social programmes. THE END IN SIGHT? Traders have scrambled to reverse expectations for US interest rate cuts this year. After a hike last month, they now expect at least three more Federal Reserve hikes before the middle of 2027. "It was the Treasury bear market that had to happen," said Andrew Lilley, chief rates strategist at Barrenjoey, an investment bank based in Sydney. "We'd been persisting in this unstable equilibrium where core inflation was unsustainably high and yet the Fed had done nothing about it," he said. "I'd say the end is in sight," Lilley said, but he added that the [USN:L8N45G0H5 TEXT:"resilience in other markets"] could come under pressure from the higher returns in bonds. European bond futures and cash bond markets in Australia, South Korea and Japan traded under pressure on Thursday.

item.title: Trump will not win this year's Nobel Peace Prize, but he may influence who does, say experts
item.description: US President Donald Trump will not win this year's Nobel Peace Prize as he wages war with Iran, but his influence will still be felt by the awarding body that picks the laureate, according to experts.
item.dc:creator: Gwladys Fouche
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump will not win this year's Nobel Peace Prize as he wages war with Iran, but his influence will still be felt by the awarding body that picks the laureate, according to experts. Last year's award, to Venezuela's [USN:L2N3VR066 TEXT:"Maria Corina Machado"], was unique in the prize's 125-year history, coming amid repeated [USN:L1N3UC0RP TEXT:"lobbying by Trump"] to get the award. Weeks later, Machado [USN:L6N3YG144 TEXT:"gave her gold Nobel medal"] to Trump, in a bid to win support for her efforts for a democratic Venezuela. This year, the five-strong body will be mindful of picking someone who can withstand pressure from Trump, according to Haakon Gjerloew, acting director of the Peace Research Institute Oslo. "I think last year's events around the Nobel Peace Prize, Maria Corina Machado giving it to Trump afterwards, will affect some of the considerations that they make," he told Reuters. "One worry the committee might have is whether awarding it to someone could put them under pressure from Donald Trump ... I think the committee will consider whether the award does more harm than good." That could mean an award to [USN:L8N45D0ES TEXT:"Pope Leo"], the [USN:L6N3V50RZ TEXT:"International Criminal Court"], the [USN:L6N3YV0K0 TEXT:"International Court of Justice"] or [USN:L6N41D1BE TEXT:"Francesca Albanese"], the UN special rapporteur on the Occupied Palestinian Territories, experts say. The announcement is on October 9. Leo, the first US-born pope, has said he would continue [USN:L8N40W0FT TEXT:"to speak out against war"], after the president [USN:L1N40W00Q TEXT:"called him "weak"]" for criticising the US conflict with Iran. The Pope's encyclical on AI, his advocacy for dialogue and the peaceful resolution of conflicts, his calls for respect for migrants and his humanitarian work could justify a prize. "The Pope stands (for) more than just as a religious figure. He has emerged as a leading thought leader," Karim Haggag, director of the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute, told Reuters. Italy's Albanese, meanwhile, has been under fire from the US and Israel for her criticism of Israel's conduct of its war against Hamas in Gaza and the occupation of the West Bank. SAFE CHOICE INSTEAD? To be sure, last year's shock events could have the opposite effect on the committee: go for a safe, uncontroversial choice less likely to antagonise Trump, who [USN:L1N3YK08W TEXT:"blamed Norway"], where the award is decided, [USN:L6N3YK0IA TEXT:"for not giving him"] the accolade last time. That could mean recognising Sudan's [USN:L6N40Y0KB TEXT:"Emergency Response Rooms"], a Sudanese network of community groups providing aid during the civil war, or non-governmental group Save the Children for helping children in conflicts. But the committee is also under scrutiny to address Trump's challenges to the international order the committee cherishes, said Oeivind Stenersen, a historian who has written about the Nobel Peace Prize. "They have a certain pressure ... to be tough against Trump," he told Reuters. "In this serious international situation, this year calls for a Peace Prize in defence of liberal democracy, international law and human rights." This could mean honouring the ICC at a time when Washington is preparing sweeping sanctions against the global tribunal, [USN:L1N45C05S TEXT:"according to sources,"] while an award to the ICJ would support respecting the sovereignty of nation-states and resolving disputes peacefully. Trump has reportedly been nominated by the leaders of [USN:L6N3TZ12B TEXT:"Cambodia"], [USN:S0N3OK054 TEXT:"Israel"] and Pakistan, but his chances were "quite low", according to Gjerloew. Trump's pressure on the Norwegian Nobel Committee has stunned many, including Nobel Peace Prize laureate [USN:L6N4560MI TEXT:"Maria Ressa"], a Filipino and American journalist, who said she watched last year with "horror". "Bullies don't run the world," she told Reuters during a visit to Oslo in September. "There are standards we live by. Might doesn't make it right."

item.title: インド製造業ＰＭＩ、9月は7カ月ぶり高水準 需要急増で
item.description: [ベンガルール １日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルがまとめたインドの９月のＨＳＢＣ製造業購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
インド製造業ＰＭＩ、9月は7カ月ぶり高水準　需要急増で 15:21 配信

インド北部ウッタル・プラデーシュ州フィロザバードのガラス工場。３月撮影。REUTERS/Bhawika Chhabra

[ベンガルール １日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルがまとめたインドの９月のＨＳＢＣ製造業購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）は需要の急増を受けて７カ月ぶり高水準となり、３カ月連続の下落に終止符を打った。雇用が回復し、企業の景況感も改善した。

• 製造業ＰＭＩは５５．１となり、５年ぶり低水準だった８月の５２．８から大幅に上昇した。だが、速報値の５５．７を下回った。

• ＰＭＩは５０．０を上回ると活動の拡大を示す。

• 電子機器、食品、医薬品、繊維製品への需要増に牽引され、新規受注が２月以来の最も速いペースで増加した。輸出受注も加速しており、製造業者はブラジル、欧州、アラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）、米国の顧客からの需要増加を挙げている。

• 生産は急増し、新規受注と旺盛な需要に支えられて、拡大ペースは５月以来の最高水準に加速した。

• ＨＳＢＣのインド担当チーフエコノミスト、プランジュル・バンダリ氏は「企業は予想される需要に備えて、原材料の購入を増やし、在庫を積み増した。完成品在庫は過去１２年近くで２番目に大きな増加を記録し、在庫削減傾向からの明確な転換を示している」と指摘した。

• 需要の増加は、雇用の回復にもつながった。雇用は５月以来最も速いペースで拡大し、８月の減少から回復した。

• ９月の企業景況感は４カ月ぶりの高水準に達し、新規の問い合わせや需要の持続に対する期待が楽観的な見方を後押しした。

• コスト圧力は高まり、電子部品、医薬品、鉄鋼の価格上昇に牽引され、投入コストのインフレ率は８月よりも速いペースで上昇した。しかし、インフレ率は依然として長期平均を下回っている。販売価格も８月から上昇したが、そのペースは緩やかで、同様にトレンドを下回った。

item.title: US investor Artisan urges UBS to quit Switzerland over capital rules
item.description: US asset manager Artisan Partners has urged UBS to leave Switzerland, arguing that proposed tougher capital requirements for the bank are "punitive", excessive and would destroy shareholder value.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US asset manager Artisan Partners has urged UBS (UBSG.S) to leave Switzerland, arguing that proposed tougher capital requirements for the bank are "punitive", excessive and would destroy shareholder value. In a letter to UBS's board published late on [USN:FWN45M16Z TEXT:"Wednesday"], the Artisan Partners Global Value Team and International Value Group, which said they manage more than 60 million UBS shares, said the planned changes would force the bank to hold billions of dollars in extra capital that would generate no return for shareholders. "The simple fact is that Switzerland is no longer an attractive or desirable location for UBS," said Artisan, which is a top-20 investor in the Zurich-based lender, according to LSEG Workspace data. "Aside from the temporary friction and cost of changing domicile, there is no compelling reason for UBS to remain a Swiss company," it added, saying the "grim reality" now facing UBS meant it was time for the bank to "part ways with a country and a regulatory structure that leave it no real choice". STRICTER CAPITAL RULES UBS said its goal was to continue operating successfully as a global bank from Switzerland. It added that it would protect shareholders' interests by continuing informed decision-making and advocating regulation that is targeted, proportionate and internationally aligned. The letter comes after Switzerland's upper house last month passed a proposal requiring UBS to back foreign units with [USN:L8N45F0DE TEXT:"90% Common Equity Tier 1"] capital as part of a banking overhaul triggered by Credit Suisse's 2023 collapse. The lower house must still debate the proposal. UBS has criticised the stricter capital rules as excessive. Chairman Colm Kelleher warned before the 90% CET1 proposal was approved that unduly harsh regulation could force the bank to reconsider its [USN:L8N4590WE TEXT:"future"] in Switzerland. According to weekend media reports, several foreign banks have expressed interest in a possible [USN:L6N45J075 TEXT:"merger"] or combination with UBS. Finance Minister Karin Keller-Sutter said she believed it was [USN:L1N45I046 TEXT:"unlikely"] the bank would leave Switzerland. Artisan estimated the proposed changes would require UBS to hold an additional $16 billion of CET1 capital. Without the stricter rules, that capital could generate an annual return of about 15%, equivalent to an extra $2.4 billion in net income, it said. Valued at 15 times earnings, that would equate to about $36 billion in lost market value, or around 23% of UBS's current market capitalisation, according to the investor's letter.

item.title: 米国防長官、将来の戦争を研究する計画にマスク氏ら起用 多様性政策を改めて批判
item.description:
ヘグセス米国防長官は30日、将来の戦争の在り方を研究する「メリディアン計画」を発表し、実業家のイーロン・マスク氏らを共同責任者に起用すると明らかにした。
南部バージニア州クアンティコの海兵隊基地で演説した。計画は国防総省の最高技術責任者が統括し、マスク氏、防衛技術企業幹部のパーマー・ラッキー氏、元米下院議長のニュート・ギングリッチ氏が共同で率いる。米国の技術者らの知見を活用し、将来の紛争を予測するとともに、新たな軍事能力の開発につなげる狙いだ。
これとは別に、米軍全体の自律型・ロボット兵器の開発や配備を担う「自律型戦闘軍」の創設も発表した。
また、多様性・公平性・包摂性（DEI）を重視する政策を改めて批判。「デブも、トランスジェンダーも、ひげ面も、変わり者も、弱虫も、急進主義者もいらない。必要なのは戦士だけだ」と述べた。
軍における宗教と精神性の重要性も強調し、精神面の健全さを身体の健康と同等に重視する方針を示した。

item.title: MLB roundup: Yankees, White Sox, Padres complete wild-card sweeps
item.description: Cody Bellinger hit a three-run homer during a six-run sixth inning and finished with four RBIs as the New York Yankees pulled away for a 9-2 rout of the Boston Red Sox on Wednesday and a two-game sweep of an American League wild-card series.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Cody Bellinger hit a three-run homer during a six-run sixth inning and finished with four RBIs as the New York Yankees pulled away for a 9-2 rout of the Boston Red Sox on Wednesday and a two-game sweep of an American League wild-card series. The Yankees led 2-1 entering the sixth before taking command with the big inning, which was capped by Bellinger's homer off Garrett Whitlock. Luis Garcia Jr. also homered for New York, which got six strong innings from left-hander Max Fried (1-0), who gave up one run on three hits over six innings. Despite the absence of Aaron Judge, who has a strained right calf, the Yankees scored 18 runs on 26 hits in the series and begin their AL Division Series against the top-seeded Tampa Bay Rays on Saturday in St. Petersburg, Fla. Red Sox starter Sonny Gray (0-1) allowed two runs on six hits over 4 2/3 innings before the bullpen crumbled. Garrett Crochet allowed four runs and recorded no outs in his first action since April 25 after missing time with a shoulder ailment. Willson Contreras and Nick Sogard homered to provide the only runs Boston scored in the series. White Sox 7, Astros 3 Chase Meidroth hit a backbreaking three-run home run in the sixth inning to help Chicago make a big early lead stand up in a victory over host Houston that capped a two-game sweep of their AL wild-card series. The White Sox jumped out to a 4-0 lead in the first inning, chasing Astros starter Hunter Brown (0-1) before he could conclude the first inning on RBI singles from Kyle Teel, Andrew Benintendi and Tristan Peters. With the sweep, Chicago earned the franchise's first postseason series victory since its sweep of the Astros in the 2005 World Series. The White Sox will face the Cleveland Guardians in a best-of-five AL Division Series that begins Saturday in Cleveland. Houston's Jeremy Pena, Cam Smith and Jose Altuve each hit solo homers off of Chicago starter Sean Burke, who allowed three runs and four hits while recording eight strikeouts over four innings. Trailing 4-3, the Astros left the bases loaded in the fifth immediately before Meidroth provided the insurance. Padres 4, Cubs 1 Gavin Sheets ripped a pinch-hit, two-run homer and San Diego clinched its National League wild-card series with a victory over visiting Chicago in Game 2. The Padres' bullpen combined to give up two hits over 5 2/3 scoreless innings as fourth-seeded San Diego swept the best-of-three series with consecutive victories. Xander Bogaerts had two hits and an RBI while Jackson Merrill and Ty France each registered two hits and a run for the Padres. San Diego advances to play the top-seeded Brewers in a best-of-five NL Division Series that begins Saturday in Milwaukee. Nico Hoerner had two hits for the Cubs, including an RBI single for the team's lone run in the series. Chicago led the majors with 850 runs in the regular season. Chicago stars Pete Crow-Armstrong and Alex Bregman each went 0-for-4 with a strikeout in Game 2. The duo finished a combined 0-for-15 with eight strikeouts in the series for the fifth-seeded Cubs. Phillies 4, Braves 3 (10 innings) Alec Bohm cracked a solo homer with two outs in the 10th to lift visiting Philadelphia to a win over Atlanta to force a winner-take-all Game 3 on Thursday in Atlanta. With Atlanta clinging to a 3-1 lead, Kyle Schwarber and Bryce Harper hit back-to-back homers leading off the eighth against Braves reliever Dylan Lee. Bohm poked his game-winning opposite-field shot off Didier Fuentes (0-1). Rookie Andrew Painter (1-0) threw three innings of scoreless relief in his postseason debut. Phillies starter Cristopher Sanchez gave up three runs over 6 2/3 innings. Matt Olson drove in two runs for the Braves, who could not make Tyler Mahle's strong start pay off. Despite suffering an abdominal pull during pregame warmups, Mahle allowed one run and six hits over seven innings. --Field Level Media

item.title: POINT MARCHÉS Wall Street en ordre dispersé après des données sur l'inflation
item.description: La Bourse de New York a fini en ordre dispersé mercredi, seul le Nasdaq ayant terminé en hausse, alors que des données moins élevées qu'attendu sur l'inflation aux Etats-Unis ont éloigné un peu aux yeux des investisseurs le spectre d'une nouvelle hausse des taux de la Réserve fédérale (Fed) dès octobre.
item.dc:creator: Chuck Mikolajczak
item.content:encoded: La Bourse de New York a fini en ordre dispersé mercredi, seul le Nasdaq ayant terminé en hausse, alors que des données moins élevées qu'attendu sur l'inflation aux Etats-Unis ont éloigné un peu aux yeux des investisseurs le spectre d'une nouvelle hausse des taux de la Réserve fédérale (Fed) dès octobre. L'indice Dow Jones (.DJI) a cédé 0,86%, ou 443,87 points, à 50.906,05 points. Le S&P-500 (.SPX) , plus large, a perdu 19,30 points, soit 0,25%, à 7.651,54 points. Le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) a avancé de son côté de 63,52 points (0,24%) à 26.861,06 points. Le Nasdaq s'inscrit dans le vert pour un deuxième mois consécutif, au contraire du S&P-500 et du Dow Jones, lequel boucle septembre dans le rouge après cinq mois d'affilée de hausse. Sur l'ensemble du troisième trimestre, le S&P-500 a pris 2,0%, le Nasdaq progressé de 2,5% et le Dow Jones cédé 2,7%. Un rapport du département américain du Commerce publié dans la journée indique que la hausse des prix de la consommation personnelle (PCE) a été moins importante qu'attendu et a ralenti en août. Des données distinctes montrent que la croissance du produit intérieur brut (PIB) des Etats-Unis a été revue à la hausse en lecture définitive au deuxième trimestre, dans le sillage d'une consommation solide et d'investissements en infrastructures pour l'intelligence artificielle (IA). La hausse des prix du carburant aux Etats-Unis, en raison du conflit avec l'Iran, a alimenté les craintes de pressions inflationnistes plus larges et a fait grimper les rendements des bons du Trésor américain. Les responsables de la Fed, qui ont procédé à un resserrement monétaire lors de leur réunion de septembre, ont signalé que des hausses supplémentaires des taux pourraient être nécessaires si l'inflation ne ralentissait pas. Selon des données FedWatch de CME, les marchés misent désormais à environ 37% seulement sur une hausse des taux en octobre, contre 51% la veille et près de 71% une semaine plus tôt. "Ce qui focalise le marché, c'est de savoir si l'économie continue de croître et si elle peut tenir avec des taux d'intérêt plus élevés", a commenté Anthony Saglimbene, stratégiste en chef d'Ameriprise Financial, dans le Michigan. "Pour l'instant, avec une économie qui progresse, avec des bénéfices solides (...), le marché peut passer outre des taux d'intérêt plus élevés", a-t-il poursuivi. Mais "si ces taux restent à des niveaux élevés pendant longtemps (...), avec un possible poids sur la croissance ou la rentabilité des entreprises, alors il devrait y avoir rapidement une réaction négative sur les marchés". La plupart des valeurs à forte croissance ont enregistré mercredi des gains, dont Amazon (AMZN.O) , Apple (AAPL.O) , Nvidia (NVDA.O) et Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , qui ont permis aux technologies (.SPLRCT) d'être l'un des rares secteurs majeurs du S&P-500 à finir en hausse. A noter également, Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE.N) a grimpé de 3,9% après avoir relevé sa prévision de chiffre d'affaires et annoncé un accord de 1,2 milliard de dollars avec Vultr. item.title: Three oil tankers hit by projectiles in Hormuz strait on Tuesday, Marisks says
item.description: Three Liberian-flagged oil tankers were struck by unknown projectiles when transiting the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday, shipping intelligence service Marisks said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Three Liberian-flagged oil tankers were struck by unknown projectiles when transiting the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday, shipping intelligence service Marisks said. The vessels had been moving through the strait with their Automatic Identification System transponders turned off to avoid detection, Marisks said in a report late on Wednesday. Oil products tanker Al Ruwais was last seen as having conducted a ship-to-ship transfer off Sohar, Oman, in late September to discharge its diesel cargo, data from analytics firm Kpler showed. Very large crude carrier Mersin Prosperity also made a ship-to-ship transfer off Sohar in mid-September to move 2 million barrels of Iraqi Basrah crude onto another vessel, Kpler data showed. Aframax-sized tanker Sinbad loaded refined products at Saudi Arabia's Jubail industrial port in early September, the data showed. ADNOC Logistics & Services (ADNOCLS.AD) , which manages Al Ruwais and Mersin Prosperity, declined to comment. Sinbad's manager, Anglo-Eastern Tanker Management, did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

item.title: Norway ready for high winter gas deliveries to Europe, Gassco says
item.description: The Norwegian transportation system for natural gas to Europe is well equipped for high gas deliveries throughout the coming winter, system operator Gassco said in a statement on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Norwegian transportation system for natural gas to Europe is well equipped for high gas deliveries throughout the coming winter, system operator Gassco said in a statement on Thursday. October marks the start of a new gas year and the beginning of the peak season for gas deliveries to Europe, Gassco said in a statement. "As we enter the winter season with maintenance completed and a well-functioning transportation system, the Norwegian continental shelf is well equipped to meet demand from Europe," Gassco's Director of System Operations Alfred Skaar Hansen said.

item.title: サウジ財政赤字、27年はＧＤＰ比3.6％予想 26年は想定上回る
item.description: [３０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[３０日 ロイター] - サウジアラビア財務省は３０日、予算編成に向けた事前声明を発表し、２０２７年の財政赤字が国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）の３．６％に相当する１９１０億リヤル（５０８億７０００万ドル）になるとの見通しを示した。

２７年の歳出総額は１兆３９００億リヤル（３７０２億１０００万ドル）、歳入は１兆２０００億リヤル（３１９６億１０００万ドル）と見込んでいる。

・２６年の財政赤字は推計２４５０億リヤルで、２５年に公表した予算で想定した１６５０億リヤルを上回る見通し。

・２７年の実質ＧＤＰ伸び率は１２．８％と想定している。

・２６年は３．６％のマイナス成長と予想し、地域の地政学的情勢により石油部門の経済活動が２１．８％縮小するとみられることを要因に挙げた。

・２７年の財政赤字は「中期債務戦略の枠組みに沿って借り入れで賄う」とし、２７年借り入れ計画の「詳細を２６年中に開示する」とした。

・サウジは石油依存度低減に向け「ビジョン２０３０」と呼ばれる大規模な経済改革を進めており、実現には数千億ドルの投資が必要という。

item.title: France-Les immatriculations de voitures neuves en hausse de 11,60% en septembre-PFA
item.description: Les immatriculations de voitures neuves en France ont augmenté en septembre de 11,60% en rythme annuel, selon les données communiquées jeudi par la Plateforme automobile (PFA).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Les immatriculations de voitures neuves en France ont augmenté en septembre de 11,60% en rythme annuel, selon les données communiquées jeudi par la Plateforme automobile (PFA). Il s'est immatriculé 156.629 véhicules particuliers dans l'Hexagone le mois dernier, a rapporté la PFA. Le mois de septembre a compté 22 jours ouvrables cette année, comme l'an dernier. Sur les neuf premiers mois de l'année, le marché a enregistré une hausse de 4,06% sur un an, avec 1.234.952 immatriculations, montrent les données. Les immatriculations de voitures neuves du groupe Stellantis , qui regroupe notamment les marques Peugeot, Citroën, DS et Opel, ont augmenté le mois dernier de 6,65% par rapport à un an plus tôt. Le groupe Renault (marques Renault, Dacia et Alpine) (RENA.PA) a vu quant à lui ses immatriculations en France progresser de 10,99% en rythme annuel en septembre. Pour sa part, le constructeur américain Tesla (TSLA.O) a vu ses ventes bondir de 61,86% sur un an le mois dernier.

item.title: NHL roundup: Penguins open campaign with 7-0 beatdown of Flyers
item.description: Nick Robertson scored twice in his Pittsburgh debut and Arturs Silovs made 19 saves as the visiting Penguins demolished the Philadelphia Flyers 7-0 on Wednesday in the season opener for both teams.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Nick Robertson scored twice in his Pittsburgh debut and Arturs Silovs made 19 saves as the visiting Penguins demolished the Philadelphia Flyers 7-0 on Wednesday in the season opener for both teams. Filip Hallander added a goal and two assists for Pittsburgh, which lost to Philadelphia in a six-game first-round playoff series last season. The Penguins had no problem in this one, as 14 players recorded at least one point, including Hendrix Lapierre (one goal, one assist), Kaedan Korczak (two assists) and Samuel Girard (two assists). Ville Koivunen, Evgeni Malkin and Egor Chinakhov added a goal apiece. Dan Vladar, a standout last season in his first campaign with the Flyers, allowed all seven goals on 38 shots. Noel Acciari, who spent the past three seasons with Pittsburgh, posted a minus-3 rating in his Philadelphia debut. Maple Leafs 2, Islanders 1 Easton Cowan had a goal and an assist in the first period, and Toronto defeated visiting New York for new coach Jim Hiller's first win. Colton Sissons also scored for the Maple Leafs, who have split their first two games. They lost their home opener 3-2 to the Montreal Canadiens on Tuesday. Anthony Stolarz made 26 saves. Emil Heineman scored for the Islanders in their season opener. Ilya Sorokin stopped 24 shots. Avalanche 8, Kings 4 Nathan MacKinnon and Artturi Lehkonen had two goals each, Mackenzie Blackwood made 27 saves and Colorado rode a four-goal second period to a victory over Los Angeles in Denver in the season opener for both teams. Brock Nelson collected a goal and two assists, Parker Kelly added a goal and assist and Nicolas Roy and Gabriel Landeskog also scored to help Colorado coach Jared Bednar celebrate his new four-year contract extension. Cale Makar, Nazem Kadri, Jaden Schwartz and Devon Toews had two assists each. Artemi Panarin, Trevor Moore, Joel Armia and Brian Dumoulin scored while Darcy Kuemper stopped 21 shots for the Kings. Alex Laferriere added two assists. --Field Level Media

item.title: La BoJ a débattu de la nécessité de nouvelles hausses de taux lors de sa réunion de septembre-"minutes"
item.description: Certains responsables de la Banque du Japon (BoJ) ont estimé qu'il était nécessaire d'accélérer le rythme des hausses de taux d'intérêt ou de les rapprocher rapidement de l'"objectif" de la banque centrale, montre le compte-rendu de leur réunion de septembre publié jeudi.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Certains responsables de la Banque du Japon (BoJ) ont estimé qu'il était nécessaire d'accélérer le rythme des hausses de taux d'intérêt ou de les rapprocher rapidement de l'"objectif" de la banque centrale, montre le compte-rendu de leur réunion de septembre publié jeudi. "Si les signes d'un écart à la hausse des prix sont observés, la BoJ devra accélérer le rythme des hausses de taux", a déclaré l'un des membres selon les "minutes". La Banque du Japon a relevé ses taux d'intérêt à leur plus haut niveau depuis 31 ans lors de sa réunion de septembre, son gouverneur indiquant que l'institution était entrée dans une nouvelle phase, axée sur la prévention d'un dépassement de l'objectif d'inflation, ouvrant ainsi la voie à de nouvelles hausses de taux.

item.title: USA-Paramount autorisé par une juge à finaliser l'acquisition de Warner Bros
item.description: Paramount a été autorisé mercredi par une ordonnance d'une juge américaine à finaliser son rachat de 110 milliards de dollars de Warner Bros , une décision qui lève l'ultime obstacle à la réalisation de cette opération d'une ampleur inédite dans le secteur.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Paramount (PSKY.O) a été autorisé mercredi par une ordonnance d'une juge américaine à finaliser son rachat de 110 milliards de dollars de Warner Bros (WBD.O) , une décision qui lève l'ultime obstacle à la réalisation de cette opération d'une ampleur inédite dans le secteur. La juge de district Araceli Martinez-Olguin a approuvé l'accord scellé la semaine dernière par les entreprises avec un groupe d'Etats américains, au premier rang desquels la Californie, qui avaient déposé un recours contre une fusion selon eux néfaste à la concurrence dans l'industrie cinématographique et télévisuelle. Aux termes de l'accord mettant fin à cette procédure en justice, Paramount devra notamment respecter des quotas sur la distribution de films en salles de cinéma pendant cinq ans et cloisonner les négociations sur la diffusion des chaînes de télévision de Warner Bros sur les réseaux câblés américains. Paramount est également convenu de mettre sur pied un comité éditorial qui sera chargé de garantir l'indépendance des chaînes d'information CBS et CNN, respectivement détenues par Paramount et Warner. L'entente entre les entreprises et les Etats américains n'a pas endigué les critiques. Des groupes opposés à la fusion Paramount-Warner avaient adressé des lettres à la cour pour l'exhorter à ne pas valider l'accord à l'amiable. Dans sa décision, la juge Araceli Martinez-Olguin a écrit que les objections soulevées ne constituaient pas des violations juridiques à même de justifier de rejeter l'accord.

item.title: 仏ケリングＣＥＯ、イタリア重視を強調 生産拠点の移管を否定
item.description: [ミラノ ３０日 ロイター] - フランスの高級ファッショングループ、ケリングのルカ・デメオ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
仏ケリングＣＥＯ、イタリア重視を強調　生産拠点の移管を否定 15:09 配信

写真は２３日、パリの店舗に展示されたグッチのスニーカー「ドリップ」。REUTERS/Abdul Saboor

[ミラノ ３０日 ロイター] - フランスの高級ファッショングループ、ケリングのルカ・デメオ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は３０日、同社の計画でイタリアは引き続き中心的な位置を占めており、同国から生産拠点を移転する意向は一切ないと明らかにした。

デメオ氏はまた、イタリアの高級ファッションブランド「アルマーニ」の少数株式取得への関心は全くないと強調。創業者ジョルジオ・アルマーニ氏の遺言書にはケリングの名前は挙げられていなかったとし、ケリングは他の経営課題に集中していると説明した。

傘下に持つイタリアのブランド「グッチ」のスニーカーの一部を中国で生産していることについて問われると、デメオ氏は特定の技術的要件によって決められたことだと説明。その上で「生産拠点を移転する、あるいはそれに類する意図は一切ない」と訴えた。

同氏はまた、ケリングのサプライチェーン（供給網）は階層が多すぎて過度に細分化されていると指摘。現在はわずか２５％のサプライヤーが調達総額の９８％を占めている状態だとし、サプライチェーンの再編に取り組んでいると明らかにした。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：債務膨張の先進国に金融危機の芽、最も懸念される米・伊・英 アングル：欧州熱波、損害保険未カバーの企業損失が拡大 アングル：トランプ氏がＮＡＴＯ首脳会議で見せた硬軟2つの顔、各国は冷静対応 アングル：トランプ氏賛美から一転、 戦略転換迫られるメローニ氏 アングル：インド「高級水」市場が急成長、富裕層にブーム到来 最終更新: 10/1(木) 15:09 ロイター

item.title: Russian manufacturing contracts slightly as job cuts hit fastest since May, PMI shows
item.description: Russia's manufacturing sector contracted slightly in September as weak demand drove further declines in output and new orders, a business survey showed on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Russia's manufacturing sector contracted slightly in September as weak demand drove further declines in output and new orders, a business survey showed on Thursday. The seasonally adjusted S&P Global Russia Manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) rose to 49.8 in September from 48.8 in August, a survey by S&P Global showed. The 50-mark separates growth from contraction. Output fell for a second straight month, though the pace of decline eased from August as firms linked lower production to weak demand and softer new order inflows. Total new orders also fell for a second month running, with companies citing higher prices and competition. Export orders dropped for an 11th consecutive month and at the sharpest pace since May 2022. Employment declined for a 10th straight month, with the pace of job shedding the fastest since May. Firms often linked lower headcounts to the non-replacement of voluntary leavers. Cost pressures remained marked but eased to a three-month low, while output price inflation slowed to the weakest since June. Supplier delivery times lengthened to the greatest extent since October 2024 amid transportation delays and logistics issues. Manufacturers were more upbeat about the year-ahead outlook, with optimism rising to a three-month high on hopes of stronger demand and new customers, although confidence remained below the series average.

item.title: India's September goods and services tax collection rises 14.7% from a year ago

item.title: ブラジル、米との会談で「関税の全面的な引き下げ」を要求
item.description: [サンパウロ／ミルウォーキー ３０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[サンパウロ／ミルウォーキー ３０日 ロイター] - ブラジルのローザ産業・貿易相は９月３０日、米中西部ミルウォーキーで開催された２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）貿易相会合の合間にグリア米通商代表部（ＵＳＴＲ）代表と会談した。ローザ氏は会談後に記者団に対し、ブラジルは米国との交渉で「関税の全面的な引き下げ」を求めていると説明した。

ブラジル政府は声明で、両国が貿易に関する合意の可能性について協議するための作業部会を設置することを明らかにした。両国とも受け入れられる合意の締結に向け、迅速に進めることを目指しているとした。

・ブラジルが引き下げを求めている米国の輸入関税には、鉄鋼・アルミニウムに対する米国の通商拡大法２３２条に基づくあらゆる関税、強制労働疑惑に関連した１２．５％の関税、および通商法３０１条に基づいた不公正貿易慣行調査の下で課された２５％の関税が含まれる。

・声明によると、米国は今後数週間以内に関税および非関税問題を含む交渉の範囲を定めた提案をする予定。

・ブラジルのビエイラ外相も同席した会談は、トランプ米大統領とブラジルのルラ大統領の電話会談に続く二国間協議に基づいている。

・ルラ氏は９月上旬に米ＣＮＮテレビに対し、米国との貿易交渉が続いている間は、いわゆる互恵法に沿った関税を米国からの輸入品に適用するつもりはないと述べた。

・ローザ氏は記者団に対し、ロシアのウクライナ侵攻を終わらせることを目的とした米国の包括的な制裁法に基づき、ブラジルによるロシア産石油製品の購入に対して１００％の関税を課される可能性についてグリア氏は言及しなかったと説明した。

・ローザ氏は、ブラジルの重要鉱物資源へのアクセスが米国との貿易交渉の議題となる可能性があるとした。一方で加工分野への付加価値創出型の投資が伴うのであれば、ブラジルは他の国々にも同様の機会を提供すると訴えた。

item.title: UK PM Burnham sows seeds of "Breturn" that could excite markets
item.description: Never mind Britain's stretched budget numbers. The real surprise this week was new Prime Minister Andy Burnham's push to re-engage with the European Union — including the possibility of rejoining. It may matter far more for markets. Even a whiff of "Breturn" could move sterling assets.
item.dc:creator: Mike Dolan
item.content:encoded: Never mind Britain's stretched budget numbers. The real surprise this week was new Prime Minister Andy [USN:L8N45L233 TEXT:"Burnham's"] push to re-engage with the European Union — including the possibility of rejoining. It may matter far more for markets. Even a whiff of "Breturn" could move sterling assets. Better EU relations have been in the policy mix since the Labour Party returned to power in 2024, but sweeping geopolitical events over the past 18 months, combined with a change of prime minister determined to pursue his core beliefs about how the country should be repaired, are now supercharging the idea. If even Canada is now eyeing [USN:L6N45910W TEXT:""associate" EU membership"] in a bid to rally the "Middle Powers", the risk that Britain could be adrift as rivalry between the world's economic and military superpowers intensifies is very real. At his Labour Party's annual conference on Tuesday, Burnham, who campaigned to stay in the EU in a 2016 Brexit referendum, argued the nation should again consider options for "Britain's long-term relationship with our European partners." He said all options from closer relations to rejoining the EU single market to re-applying for membership would be on the table for his party and the wider public to consider. But instead of setting it aside on a long to-do list, Burnham doubled down on the idea in interviews right through Wednesday — re-emphasising that full reversal of Brexit was one of the options. Britain can't decide this on its own, of course. [USN:S8N3OI00C TEXT:"EU governments"] have shown little appetite for reopening accession talks, domestic opposition remains vocal, and any transition would carry its own costs. Moreover, any process could take many years. But the direction of travel could well excite investment and markets long before the destination. At the core of Burnham's message was the most basic observation: "Brexit has done more harm than good." More than a decade after the narrow referendum to leave the EU, that view has substantial support among the public and many economists. With the referendum's anniversary marked in June, reams of analysis on the economic impact poured out. While formal Brexit didn't happen until the height of the 2020 pandemic, making cause and effect hard to disentangle, the only real debate among economists now is how much the decision hit trade and gross domestic product (GDP) — not whether. The Office for Budget Responsibility estimates range from a cumulative 4-percentage-point hit to UK productivity to a long-term lowering of 15 percentage points of imports and exports. The total effect on British GDP is estimated at anywhere up to 6-8 percentage points . Even more benign scenarios — such as Deutsche Bank's "doppelganger" approach, which looks at how Britain might have performed if it hadn't left — see the cumulative GDP hit at as much as 4 percentage points. That's before you get to the business and financial complications related to renewed barriers, red tape and movement restrictions between Britain and its biggest trading partner. Even the loudest rallying cry of Brexit — to reduce immigration — didn't reduce overall numbers to any significant degree; it only shifted their origin. Opinion polls show significant regret — underlining why Burnham may feel confident in broaching the issue politically. A YouGov poll published early in September showed 55% of respondents felt Brexit marked a "wrong turn" — compared with just 21% who thought the opposite and 11% who were equivocal. A separate poll found some 55% in favour of rejoining. And an Ipsos poll earlier in the year showed 52% favoured re-applying for EU membership compared with 33% who wanted to stay out. SLOW BURN? It's true that Burnham's speech initially produced no financial-market fireworks. Bond markets were more focused on pension and social care reforms and other domestic initiatives, broadly applauded by commentators. Helped by an upgrade to second-quarter GDP estimates, sterling was more buoyant on Tuesday against both the dollar and euro — and gilts may have surfed some of the Burnham momentum too. After all, the pound was the biggest casualty of the 2016 referendum, with its effective exchange rate index plunging 14% in just three months after the vote. After a slow rebuild, it's taken a decade to get back close to where it was before the shock — even though it remains down about 10% against the euro and dollar and still has a considerable gap to close. A harder job will be to repair the widely worrying underperformance of UK equities (.FTSE) over the past decade and what many still see as a gaping "Brexit discount" between UK stock valuations and those of euro zone counterparts — never mind Wall Street. For some, Brexit, or its reversal, now seems as central to Britain's most pressing issues as welfare reform and defence. Burnham's intervention suggested a willingness to confront the really big questions rather than dancing around them. Economist Anatole Kaletsky at GaveKal Research reckoned Burnham's speech may be seen as a pivotal moment for the UK economy and "a bullish inflection point for sterling assets." "These are the great issues that will determine whether Britain prospers or stumbles in the decades ahead," he added. A decade of confusion and loss of direction in Britain might be coming to a close — just as the rest of the world becomes harder to navigate. (The opinions expressed here are those of Mike Dolan , a columnist for Reuters.) Enjoying this column? item.title: Bangladesh's coal turn is a fresh bad sign for LNG exporters
item.description: Bangladesh should be one of the global LNG industry's success stories, but instead it is a warning sign.
item.dc:creator: Gavin Maguire
item.content:encoded: Bangladesh should be one of the global LNG industry's success stories, but instead it is a warning sign. Few countries better fit the profile of a future liquefied natural gas growth market. Electricity demand is rising, domestic gas reserves are falling, and policymakers have invested heavily in LNG import infrastructure to bridge the gap. For years, those trends helped make Bangladesh a veritable poster child among LNG bulls who argued that rapidly growing Asian economies would underpin LNG demand growth for decades. Instead, Bangladesh has crossed a milestone that should give LNG investors pause. Coal-fired electricity generation overtook gas-fired generation for the first time this summer, data from Ember shows, marking a dramatic shift for a country where gas previously accounted for over 90% of electricity supplies. Coal-fired electricity output was 3.92 terawatt hours (TWh) in July, compared to 3.66 TWh of generation from gas-fired plants. That flip is significant because it has implications for gas use trends across the broader developing world. COAL COMPETITION The LNG industry's growth story rests on a relatively small group of markets. Demand in Europe is expected to flatten or decline over time as renewables expand. Japan and South Korea remain major gas importers but both have more new nuclear power generation capacity under construction than gas-fired capacity, according to Global Energy Monitor (GEM), which should limit gas-fired growth. China remains important, but its energy strategy is also mainly focused on developing domestic clean energy supplies and limiting fossil fuel import reliance. That leaves emerging Asia, where countries such as Bangladesh, Pakistan, Vietnam and the Philippines have long been viewed as the next generation of LNG buyers. Those countries are expected to account for much of the growth needed to absorb the massive wave of LNG export capacity being built in the United States, Qatar and elsewhere. The problem is that these countries are also among the world's most price-sensitive energy consumers. Bangladesh's latest power mix data illustrates the challenge. Despite expanding access to LNG imports, gas is losing market share to cheaper coal. That is the opposite of what LNG bulls need to see. ECONOMIC PAIN The shift in Bangladesh's power mix is primarily driven by costs. Developing economies need reliable electricity, but it needs to be cheap and abundant enough to support industrial growth and expanding urban populations. In many cases, those priorities outweigh concerns about emissions, and put LNG at a disadvantage. Unlike domestic energy sources, LNG exposes buyers to global fuel markets. And following the outbreak of Russia's war with Ukraine in 2022 and the US and Israeli war with Iran in 2026, global gas buyers have received the painful message that gas imports can get very expensive. Since the first US and Israeli strikes against Iran in late February, Asian LNG prices have surged from around $11 per million British thermal units (MMBtu) to over $25/MMBtu, dealing a stinging blow to cost-sensitive buyers, LSEG data shows. Of course, coal carries its own risks, but remains substantially cheaper in Asia at the equivalent of around $6.50/MMBtu for supplies from Australia and nearer $5.00/MMBtu from Indonesia, according to LSEG. And when governments are trying to keep electricity affordable, those considerations matter. BROADER MESSAGE What makes Bangladesh notable is that it appears to be part of a broader pattern. Several Asian countries have registered steady declines in natural gas's share of their generation mixes in recent years, including Pakistan and India, which were also viewed as high-potential LNG markets. Even in Japan, one of the world's largest LNG importers, gas's share of the electricity mix has declined from over 40% in 2020 to around 28% so far this year, Ember data shows. China is also registering declining gas intensity in power generation. Despite becoming the world's largest LNG importer, gas remains only a marginal contributor in China's electricity production, accounting for around 3% of the generation mix so far in 2026. These declines in gas reliance for power generation in key Asian markets undermine arguments that rising electricity demand automatically triggers rising gas consumption. Indeed, across much of Asia, gas is finding itself squeezed between rapidly growing renewable power and a coal sector that remains difficult to dislodge. STAYING POWER Much of the energy-transition debate was previously framed around the idea that gas would gradually displace coal in emerging markets, before being displaced itself by renewables and batteries. But those discussions overlook the fact that many power operators across Asia remain in no rush to replace coal systems that they have spent decades building and remain cheap to operate. As a result, every new LNG cargo must justify its cost against a fuel that many developing countries prefer on cost and reliability grounds. The result is a challenging commercial reality for the LNG export sector. While wealthy economies may value gas for its emissions advantages and flexibility, lower-income economies often place a higher premium on affordability. That creates an uncomfortable mismatch between where LNG suppliers need demand growth and where LNG can most easily compete. WARNING SIGNS None of this means LNG demand is about to collapse. Global gas consumption continues to grow in many markets, and new import infrastructure continues to be built. But Bangladesh offers a valuable reminder that future demand is unlikely to be as automatic as some projections assume. The world's LNG industry is currently investing billions of dollars in new export capacity based on the assumption that developing economies will steadily increase gas consumption as their electricity systems expand. Bangladesh's experience highlights that gas use has the potential to follow a declining trajectory instead, and may lead LNG investors to ask how many other countries may follow similar paths. The opinions expressed here are those of the author , a columnist for Reuters. Enjoying this column? Check out Reuters Open Interest (ROI), your essential new source for global financial commentary.
