item.title: Malaysia Aviation Group signs deal to buy Airbus unit Sepang Aircraft Engineering
item.description: Malaysia Aviation Group, the parent of national carrier Malaysia Airlines, said on Thursday it has signed a sale and purchase agreement to acquire Airbus unit Sepang Aircraft Engineering.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Malaysia Aviation Group, the parent of national carrier Malaysia Airlines, said on Thursday it has signed a sale and purchase agreement to acquire Airbus (AIR.PA) unit Sepang Aircraft Engineering. The proposed acquisition will support MAG's long-term business plan to strengthen its engineering and maintenance capabilities, expand its services portfolio and grow third-party revenue, it said in a statement. No deal value was disclosed. The transaction, targeted for completion in 2027, remains subject to the fulfillment of customary conditions, including approval from Malaysia's civil aviation authority, MAG said.

item.title: Sanofi to pay Regeneron $1 billion upfront in expanded immunology deal
item.description: French drugmaker Sanofi said on Thursday it would pay US partner Regeneron $1 billion upfront and up to $7 billion more in milestone payments to add four next-generation, long-acting immunology antibodies to the partnership behind their blockbuster eczema drug Dupixent.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: French drugmaker Sanofi (SASY.PA) said on Thursday it would pay US partner Regeneron (REGN.O) $1 billion upfront and up to $7 billion more in milestone payments to add four next-generation, long-acting immunology antibodies to the partnership behind their blockbuster eczema drug Dupixent. The companies said they had settled earlier litigation over the collaboration and that they would split costs and profits of the expanded partnership equally. The four antibodies target the same type 2 inflammation pathways as Dupixent, which more than 1.5 million patients use across nine indications Regeneron will lead research and development and Sanofi will lead global sales The existing Dupixent profit-sharing terms will not change Regeneron also has the option to join Sanofi's experimental drug lunsekimig once its late-stage trials for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease are finished

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝村上所属Ｗソックスが地区Ｓ進出、カブスは敗退 ＷＣＳ
item.description: ［３０日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［３０日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）は３０日、各地でワイルドカードシリーズ（ＷＣＳ＝３回戦制）の第２戦を行い、ア・リーグのホワイトソックスはアストロズを７─３で退け、２連勝で地区シリーズ進出を決めた。

ホワイトソックスの村上宗隆内野手は「４番・一塁」で出場し、５打数ノーヒット、３三振。昨年までプロ野球ＤｅＮＡに所属したアンソニー・ケイ投手が３番手として五回途中から２／３回を投げて無失点１四球に抑え、勝利投手となった。ホワイトソックスがポストシーズンのシリーズで勝利を収めたのは、優勝した２００５年のワールドシリーズ以来、２１年ぶり。

同じア・リーグのヤンキースはレッドソックスに９─２で勝利し、２連勝で突破を決めた。

ア・リーグのカブスはパドレスに１─４で敗れ、シリーズ２連敗で姿を消した。カブスの鈴木誠也外野手は「４番・右翼」で出場し、４打数１安打、２三振だった。

ナ・リーグのもう１試合ではフィリーズが延長十回の末にブレーブスを４─３で下し、１勝１敗のタイに持ち込んだ。

item.title: Avs' firepower on full display in 8-4 victory over Kings
item.description: Nathan MacKinnon and Artturi Lehkonen had two goals each, Mackenzie Blackwood made 27 saves and the Colorado Avalanche used a four-goal second period to beat the Los Angeles Kings 8-4 in Denver on Wednesday night in the season opener for both teams.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Nathan MacKinnon and Artturi Lehkonen had two goals each, Mackenzie Blackwood made 27 saves and the Colorado Avalanche used a four-goal second period to beat the Los Angeles Kings 8-4 in Denver on Wednesday night in the season opener for both teams. Brock Nelson collected a goal and two assists, Parker Kelly added a goal and assist and Nicolas Roy and Gabriel Landeskog also scored to help Colorado coach Jared Bednar celebrate his four-year contract extension. Bednar was entering the final year of his existing contract when the deal was announced Wednesday morning. Cale Makar, Nazem Kadri, Jaden Schwartz and Devon Toews had two assists each. Landeskog scored in the third period, less than a minute after MacKinnon dropped the gloves for a rare fight by the superstar center. Artemi Panarin, Trevor Moore, Joel Armia and Brian Dumoulin scored while Darcy Kuemper stopped 21 shots for the Kings. Los Angeles' Alex Laferriere added two assists. Colorado went ahead 1-0 on a power play early in the first with Nelson's goal off the first of Schwartz's assists. Dumoulin tied it at 15:14 of the first with a shot from the top of the left circle, and the Kings had a chance to get another on the power play. Josh Manson chipped the puck along the boards to Kelly, who carried it into the Los Angeles zone on an odd-man rush and beat Kuemper at 17:58 of the opening frame. Los Angeles took penalties 40 seconds apart late in the first. MacKinnon scored on the two-man advantage 23 seconds into the second period, but Armia answered 1:05 later to cut the Kings' deficit to 3-2. MacKinnon made it a two-score game with his second goal at 8:33, and the teams combined for three goals in the final 3:59 of the middle period. Roy made it 5-2 when he scored while Schwartz was face down in the crease. Moore produced a short-handed goal at 17:50, but Lehkonen answered on the same power play 44 seconds later to restore the three-goal lead. Panarin cut Los Angeles' deficit to 6-4 at 11:51 of the third, but Landeskog and Lehkonen scored 1:03 apart, the latter on a power play, to cap the scoring. --Field Level Media

item.title: Turkey's main stock index enters bear market, posts worst month since 2008
item.description: Turkey's main share index entered a bear market and posted its worst monthly performance since 2008 in September after a selloff triggered by cash-strapped investment funds spread across the broader market.
item.dc:creator: Mirac Dereli
item.content:encoded: Turkey's main share index (.XU100) entered a bear market and posted its worst monthly performance since 2008 in September after a selloff triggered by cash-strapped investment funds [USN:L8N45A0T5 TEXT:"spread across the broader"] market. The index closed down 2.79% on Wednesday, more than 20% below its May 11 record close, confirming a bear market. It ended September down 16.65%. The selloff accelerated on September 14 on concerns over funds heavily exposed to thinly traded stocks. Analysts said some funds were forced to sell liquid holdings to meet redemption requests, driving broader declines and triggering further withdrawals. The index fell more than 8% in the week ended September 18, its worst weekly performance since March 2025, when the jailing of Istanbul Mayor Ekrem Imamoglu triggered a sharp selloff. The Capital Markets Board (SPK) on September 17 ordered the liquidation of [USN:L6N45L0PJ TEXT:"131 funds managing"] more than $20 billion and serving 455,758 retail investors. Regulators have since widened their investigation into alleged market manipulation in stocks and fund markets. Justice Minister Akin Gurlek [USN:L8N45M11P TEXT:"said on Wednesday"] that the number of suspects had risen to 217, with 56 jailed pending trial. SMALLER STOCKS HIT HARDEST Istanbul's index of companies outside the top 100 (.XTUMY) , which has 484 constituents, had outperformed the benchmark (.XU100) since the start of 2025. The gap, however, has narrowed sharply after the SPK in late August restricted how much of a fund's assets can be concentrated in individual companies. The index (.XTUMY) fell roughly 35% in September, its worst monthly performance in lira terms since its launch in 2009. The blue-chip top 30 index (.XU030) fell less to close September down 9.8%. By contrast, the (.XYUZO) index, which includes the remaining 70 stocks in the top 100, has borne the brunt of the selloff since January 2025, with 15 constituents losing between 50% and 90% of their value in September, according to LSEG-compiled data.

item.title: 中国テンセント、オラクルとＡＩチップ10万個のリース契約＝ＦＴ
item.description: [３０日 ロイター] - 中国のゲーム・インターネット企業、騰訊控股（テンセント・ホールディングス）は、中国国内では...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国テンセント、オラクルとＡＩチップ10万個のリース契約＝ＦＴ 14:14 配信

テンセントのロゴ。6月、中国内モンゴル自治区フフホト市で撮影。REUTERS/Maxim Shemetov

[３０日 ロイター] - 中国のゲーム・インターネット企業、騰訊控股（テンセント・ホールディングス）は、中国国内では入手できない約１０万個の高度な人工知能（ＡＩ）チップを利用するため、米クラウドプロバイダーのオラクルと海外リース契約を締結した。英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）が３０日、事情に詳しい関係者の話として伝えた。海外リース契約額はテンセントにとって過去最大規模という。

ＦＴによると、テンセントは今年、東南アジアにあるオラクルの複数のデータセンターを対象に５年間のリース契約に合意した。契約総額は約７０億ドルと推定され、前払金は約３０％に上るという。

ロイターはこの報道を裏付けることはできていない。

オラクルとテンセントは、この報道に関するロイターのコメント要請に直ちに応じていない。

テンセントが大規模言語モデルの開発と導入への投資を拡大する中、同社のＡＩ事業拡大に伴うコンピューティング需要は急増している。

item.title: ＮＺ議会解散、11月総選挙へ 与党連合と左派勢力の接戦に
item.description: [１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１日 ロイター] - ニュージーランド（ＮＺ）議会が１日解散し、１１月の総選挙に向けた選挙戦が正式に始まった。中道右派の連立与党と、労働党を中心とする左派勢力の接戦となる見通しだ。

各党は１１月７日の投票に向け、生活費問題や経済運営、公共サービスを重点課題に掲げている。

今週公表された注目度の高い１Ｎｅｗｓ・ベリアンの世論調査では、労働党が主導するとみられる左派連合が６５議席を獲得し、政権を樹立する可能性が示された。一方、国民党、ＡＣＴ党、ニュージーランド・ファースト党からなる現在の連立与党は５９議席にとどまる見通しとなった。

一部の世論調査によると、中道の新興政党「オポチュニティー党」が、今回の選挙でキャスチングボートを握る可能性がある。

ニュージーランドでは３０年前にドイツ型の小選挙区比例代表併用制が導入されて以来、連立政権が一般的となっている。

議会の定数は通常１２０。ただ、ある政党が獲得した小選挙区の議席数が、全国の政党票の得票率から割り当てられる議席数を上回った場合は、議席が追加されることがある。

item.title: India's factory growth climbs to 7-month high on surging demand, PMI shows
item.description: India's manufacturing sector expanded sharply in September, ending a three-month slowdown as robust demand drove the fastest growth in factory activity in seven months, revived hiring and lifted business confidence, a private survey showed on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India's manufacturing sector expanded sharply in September, ending a three-month slowdown as robust demand drove the fastest growth in factory activity in seven months, revived hiring and lifted business confidence, a private survey showed on Thursday. The HSBC India Manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) (INPMI=ECI) , compiled by S&P Global, jumped to 55.1 in September from a five-year low of 52.8 in August but was lower than a [USN:ZUN00FD8X TEXT:"preliminary"] estimate of 55.7. The reading was the highest since February. A PMI reading above 50.0 indicates growth in activity. New orders rose at the fastest pace since February, driven by stronger demand for electronic, food, pharmaceutical and textile products, the survey said. Export orders also accelerated, with manufacturers citing increased demand from clients in Brazil, Europe, the UAE and the US. Output rose sharply, with the rate of expansion accelerating to its strongest since May, supported by new business orders and high demand. "Companies bought more materials and built up stocks to prepare for anticipated sales. Finished-goods inventories recorded their second-largest increase in nearly 12 years, signalling a clear shift from leaner stock levels," said Pranjul Bhandari, chief India economist at HSBC. Rising demand also led to a resumption in hiring. Employment expanded at its strongest rate since May, recovering from an outright decline in August - the first drop in factory jobs in two-and-a-half years. Business confidence rose to a four-month high in September with optimism buoyed by new enquiries and expectations of sustained demand. Cost pressures rose, with input cost inflation rising at a faster pace than in August, driven by higher prices for electronic components, pharmaceutical items and steel. However, the rate of inflation remained below its long-run average. Selling prices also increased from August, though the pace was modest and similarly below trend. [USN:L4N4560OU TEXT:"Inflation"] has remained above the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) 4% medium-term target for the third consecutive month in August, driven by a sharp increase in energy and food costs. To tackle rising inflation, the [USN:L4N45K09D TEXT:"RBI"] is expected to raise interest rates by a total of 50 basis points this year to 5.75%.

item.title: Treasury's smaller-than-expected buybacks fuel debate over aims
item.description: The US Treasury is purchasing fewer bonds than expected in its buybacks of longer-dated debt, even after recently expanding the program's scope, stoking debate among investors over its aims and whether it is succeeding.
item.dc:creator: Karen Brettell
item.content:encoded: The US Treasury is purchasing fewer bonds than expected in its buybacks of longer-dated debt, even after recently expanding the program's scope, stoking debate among investors over its aims and whether it is succeeding. The program enables bondholders to offer specific securities to Treasury with the prices at which they are willing to sell. Treasury can repurchase up to its cap, [USN:L1N44G0GD TEXT:"raised last month"] to $6 billion from $2 billion, but it can also reject offers deemed too expensive. In its most recent operations, the Treasury has accepted around half the bonds offered and in each case it has fallen short of its stated repurchase cap. At the same time, purchases have been concentrated in only a few issues. Some portfolio managers and analysts have questioned why the government publicly increased the size of the program if it wasn't going to buy as many bonds as it could, while others say it is doing what it promised. The Treasury is "perfectly entitled to buy back less than they could if they don't like the terms," said Padhraic Garvey, regional head of research, Americas at ING, adding it "has always got the option to buy more." SUFFICIENT LIQUIDITY Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has cast the purchases as a technical measure to help investors trade older, less liquid government bonds. If the program's main job is to backstop liquidity, broadly defined as the capacity to buy and sell at current prices without moving the market, it seems to be working. Yields have risen in recent weeks but trading hasn't been particularly difficult. "If they really need the liquidity, they'll give an aggressive offer in," said Thomas Simons, chief US economist at Jefferies. Investors holding out for higher prices, he added, "don't clearly need the liquidity that bad." The smaller acceptance rate may also reflect the program's progress in removing older, less actively traded bonds from the market, with the remaining holders having little need to sell, or being reluctant to part with the securities. Simons notes several earlier long-end buybacks attracted roughly $20 billion to $30 billion in submissions, compared with $10.47 billion at the most recent operation. The Treasury will buy up to another $6 billion in 10-to-20-year debt on Thursday. “Over time, the least liquid dogs on the curve will eventually disappear from the market and then they don’t need to do as much liquidity support,” he said. Many of the bonds targeted are low-coupon securities issued during the COVID-era period of extremely low interest rates. With market yields now much higher, those bonds have fallen substantially below face value and can be difficult to trade in size -- and potentially cheap to repurchase. That creates a possible debt-management rationale alongside the liquidity one, said John Luke Tyner, head of fixed income and portfolio manager at Aptus Capital Advisors. "If Bessent can buy back these bonds that were issued during COVID period and they're pricing at 50 to 60 cents on the dollar ... that seems like a great way to do it," Tyner said. Yet Treasury still has to finance the buybacks, potentially by issuing short-term bills at interest rates far higher than the coupons on the securities being retired. CONFUSION OVER PROGRAM'S INTENT The broader confusion over the program dates to its August 19 expansion, when Treasury said it would at least double buyback sizes for 10- to 30-year debt. The announcement came two weeks after the quarterly refunding, the forum where investors have come to expect updates on borrowing and debt-management plans. The next quarterly refunding is set for the first week in November. The unusual timing, combined with a sell off that was already pushing yields higher, encouraged investors to interpret the move as an effort to cap yields, Simons said. "It was an out-of-cycle communication, something that was delivered with the timing that was not within their norms at all," he said. Long-end Treasury yields have kept climbing since the buyback was announced, but Garvey said that reflects the market pricing in a Federal Reserve that keeps rates higher for longer, not a failed operation. The better gauge, he said, is the swap spread, a measure of how expensive Treasuries are against the private lending benchmark SOFR. That spread has narrowed, indicating that the operation is working according to Bessent’s aims, Garvey said. “He's narrowed the swap spread," Garvey said. "That's all he can do.”

item.title: US sees Chinese invasion of Taiwan unlikely next year despite 2027 timeline, sources say
item.description: US officials believe a Chinese invasion of Taiwan before 2028 is increasingly unlikely despite Chinese President Xi Jinping's instructions for his military to be ready by 2027 to take the democratically governed island by force, if needed, people familiar with US thinking said.
item.dc:creator: Phil Stewart, Idrees Ali
item.content:encoded: US officials believe a Chinese invasion of Taiwan before 2028 is increasingly unlikely despite Chinese President Xi Jinping's instructions for his military to be ready by 2027 to take the democratically governed island by force, if needed, people familiar with US thinking said. The main reasons include delays in military readiness amid the Chinese Communist Party's anti-corruption campaign as well as Beijing's eagerness to see the results of Taiwan's 2028 election, which some Chinese officials hope could usher in a government more amenable to bringing the island under Chinese control, according to two current US officials, one former US official and a person familiar with the matter. Beijing may increasingly look to use force in 2028 and beyond if Taiwan's election sees the Democratic Progressive Party win a fourth consecutive term, and in particular if current President Lai Ching-te wins reelection, the people added. "If that happens, I think 2028 becomes pretty sporty," said one of the US officials, who like the other sources spoke on condition of anonymity. Lai, who took office two years ago, and his ruling DPP, champion Taiwan's separate identity from China , a position that frequently angers Beijing, which views the island as an inviolable part of Chinese territory. Taiwan strongly objects to China's claims and says only its people can decide their future. The assessment, which has not previously been reported, is a significant update to the years-long understanding among US officials that Xi wanted his military ready to potentially take Taiwan by force in 2027, the centenary of the founding of its People's Liberation Army. China has never ruled out using force to bring Taiwan under its control but has never publicly confirmed a 2027 readiness order. The Pentagon declined to comment. China's US embassy and Taiwan's representative office in Washington did not immediately respond to a request for comment. In a speech this week, Xi referred to Taiwan and talked about promoting the peaceful development of cross-strait relations to achieve "reunification." The 2027 benchmark, which analysts say is about Chinese military preparedness rather than a timeline for invasion, has for years created a sense of urgency across multiple US administrations in countering China in the Asia-Pacific region. The US intelligence community has hinted at Chinese wariness before. It said in its annual threat assessment in March that China did not, at least at that point, have a plan to invade Taiwan next year and still preferred to wrest control of the island without the use of force, if possible. US ELECTIONS AS A FACTOR? The US is Taiwan's most important international backer and weapons supplier despite a lack of formal diplomatic ties, and US officials offered mixed assessments of the degree to which China might view the 2028 US presidential election as an important indicator for military action. While three of the people familiar with the matter said Beijing may also want to evaluate the outcome of the US election, particularly given rising American voter antipathy toward US military action abroad, the first US official said Beijing viewed both Democrats and Republicans as largely aligned on Taiwan. While China might have a preference in the 2028 US election, "it doesn't become as decisive a factor in my opinion, as it might have been 15 years ago," the official said. US President Donald Trump has downplayed the likelihood of a Chinese invasion of Taiwan during his presidency, going so far as to say last year that Xi told him China would not invade while he was in office. Trump made limited comments on Taiwan after hosting Xi in Washington last week, saying only that the issue of Taiwan came up when the two spoke and that Xi understood his position. China calls Taiwan its single most important issue and a matter of Chinese sovereignty and territorial integrity. It has called for an end to US arms sales to Taiwan. Since his May trip to Beijing, Trump has held off on approving a new arms package worth some $14 billion, describing it as a "negotiating chip." For years, the US strategy has focused on arming Taiwan so that it can hold off Chinese forces long enough for the United States and others to come to its aid. ANTI-CORRUPTION DRIVE China's Xi has not rescinded his goal for the People's Liberation Army to have the capabilities available to take Taiwan by force by next year, officials say. But the military didn't accomplish as much last year militarily as it probably had intended because of the impact of China's anti-corruption campaign, the people said. Since coming to power in 2012, Xi has unleashed a sweeping corruption and discipline crackdown. Millions within China's vast bureaucracy have been investigated, with scores of senior party, government and military officials ensnared and purged. In recent years, the People's Liberation Army has been a target of the campaign. A string of investigations and expulsions has left just two active officials on the formerly seven-member Central Military Commission, including Xi himself, who serves as chair. SHORT, SHARP WAR China's military exercises last year were smaller and less threatening compared to the past several years, according to the US official. While they bounced back a bit this year, the official suggested Chinese military officials were dissatisfied with their readiness. The official said China was believed to have drawn a lesson from the wars in Iran and Ukraine, which is the need to move quickly once any invasion begins and avoid getting bogged down in a sustained conflict. More work remained for China. "There are way too many pieces that aren't quite in place yet for what would be the most difficult military operation any military has attempted probably since the Allied invasion of Normandy," the official said.

item.title: AI adoption stalls as companies struggle to scale projects despite strong returns, study shows
item.description: Only 13% of companies were on track with their AI initiatives, as regulatory hurdles and integration with legacy IT systems slowed large-scale adoption, a BearingPoint study found.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Only 13% of companies were on track with their AI initiatives, as regulatory hurdles and integration with legacy IT systems slowed large-scale adoption, a BearingPoint study found. Nearly three-quarters of companies surveyed reported positive financial results from AI but less than a third could move beyond pilot projects, the consultancy firm said on Thursday. "AI has crossed an important threshold," said BearingPoint expert Frederic Gigant, and added that proving value and scaling it were two different things About 40% of respondents cited legal regulations as the main barrier to scaling AI, while 34% pointed to challenges integrating the new technology into existing IT systems Around 24% of companies reported AI-driven cost savings of at least 10%, compared with just 4% reporting revenue growth of the same scale Nearly two-thirds of companies estimated excess staffing levels of at least 10% China and the US lead AI adoption, with 20% and 18% of companies reporting comprehensive implementation, versus 8% in Germany The share of companies with AI deeply integrated into operations rose to 11% in 2026 from 7% in 2025

item.title: Passagiere vereiteln Absturz von Flydubai-Maschine - Israel verschärft Kontrollen
item.description: Passagiere und Besatzungsmitglieder eines Flydubai-Fluges haben israelischen Behörden zufolge den Versuch eines Co-Piloten vereitelt, die Maschine zum Absturz zu bringen. Der Mann habe den Flugkapitän mit einem Messer angegriffen und das Flugzeug in weniger als 30 Sekunden knapp 4300 Meter in die Tiefe stürzen lassen, teilten die Beamten am Mittwoch mit. Daraufhin seien Passagiere und Crew in das Cockpit eingedrungen und hätten den Angreifer überwältigt. Ein zweites Paar Flydubai-Piloten, das sich an Bord befand, habe den Jet anschließend sicher im saudiarabischen Tabuk gelandet.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Passagiere und Besatzungsmitglieder eines Flydubai-Fluges haben israelischen Behörden zufolge den Versuch eines Co-Piloten vereitelt, die Maschine zum Absturz zu bringen. Der Mann habe den Flugkapitän mit einem Messer angegriffen und das Flugzeug in weniger als 30 Sekunden knapp 4300 Meter in die Tiefe stürzen lassen, teilten die Beamten am Mittwoch mit. Daraufhin seien Passagiere und Crew in das Cockpit eingedrungen und hätten den Angreifer überwältigt. Ein zweites Paar Flydubai-Piloten, das sich an Bord befand, habe den Jet anschließend sicher im saudiarabischen Tabuk gelandet. Die Hintergründe der Tat sind nach israelischen Angaben noch unklar. Ein israelischer Insider sagte, der Co-Pilot sei ein omanischer Staatsbürger. Der Oman äußerte sich zunächst nicht. Die staatliche Fluggesellschaft Flydubai teilte lediglich mit, es habe eine "Auseinandersetzung" im Cockpit gegeben, und warnte vor "voreiligen Spekulationen". Mehr als zehn Stunden nach dem Vorfall trafen die Reisenden mit einer Ersatzmaschine auf dem Ben-Gurion-Flughafen in Tel Aviv ein. Der israelische Ministerpräsident Benjamin Netanjahu sprach von einem "schweren Sicherheitsvorfall" und kündigte an, dass die saudiarabischen Behörden den Co-Piloten verhören würden. An Bord des Fluges FZ1073 von Dubai nach Tel Aviv befanden sich Netanjahu zufolge 174 Menschen, die meisten von ihnen Israelis. Einem Sprecher Netanjahus zufolge wurde der indische Flugkapitän verletzt und habe geblutet. Dennoch sei es ihm gelungen, die Cockpittür zu entriegeln. Daraufhin seien Passagiere ins Cockpit gekommen, während der Co-Pilot auf das Bedienfeld des Flugzeugs eingeschlagen habe. Nach Angaben des Flughafens in Tabuk wurden beide Piloten mit Verletzungen in ein Krankenhaus eingeliefert. Der Vorfall verschärft die Sorgen um die Flugsicherheit in der Region. Israel erklärte, man werde die Kontrollen von Piloten ausländischer Airlines verschärfen. "Wir werden die Identität jedes Piloten kennen, der nach Israel fliegt, und eine Art Sicherheitsüberprüfung vornehmen", sagte Regierungssprecher Doron Spielman der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters.

item.title: 英、新たな気候情報開示基準の義務化見送り 企業負担や競争力に配慮
item.description:
Phoebe Seers Kirstin Ridley
[ロンドン ３０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Phoebe Seers　Kirstin Ridley

[ロンドン ３０日 ロイター] - 英金融行動監視機構（ＦＣＡ）は３０日、上場企業に新たな気候関連情報の開示基準への準拠を義務付ける計画を撤回したことを、最終規則の公表を通じて明らかにした。

企業側から対応コストや英国市場の競争力への影響を懸念する声が上がったことを受け、情報を開示しない場合に理由の説明を求める現行の「コンプライ・オア・エクスプレイン（順守か説明か）」方式を維持する。各国・地域の政府や規制当局が企業の報告負担を見直す中、気候関連情報の開示規制を厳格化する方針を後退させた形だ。

ＦＣＡは１月、上場企業に対して重要な気候変動関連のリスクと機会、気候目標、気候変動が事業に及ぼす潜在的な影響などを盛り込んだ英国の新たな気候情報開示基準への準拠を求める案を示していた。しかし最終規則では義務化を見送り、企業が開示しない理由を説明すれば非開示を選択できる現行方式を継続することにした。

気候情報開示を巡っては、主要国・地域で規制を緩和する動きが相次いでいる。欧州連合（ＥＵ）は主要な企業情報開示制度の一部を緩和し、トランプ米政権も気候関連情報の開示規則を導入する計画を取りやめた。

ＦＣＡの規則案に対する意見募集では、企業から対応コストに加え、上場先としての英国の競争力に悪影響を及ぼすとの懸念が示されていた。

英国の上場企業を代表するクオーテッド・カンパニーズ・アライアンス（ＱＣＡ）は、柔軟性やバランスを重視した規制措置を歓迎すると表明。金融業界団体ＵＫファイナンスのサステナビリティー政策担当ディレクター、イアン・ブラー氏は、今回の変更は企業の報告負担の軽減につながる一方、金融機関や投資家が企業のサステナビリティーに関するリスクや戦略を評価するために利用できる情報が減る可能性があると指摘した

ＦＣＡは２０２０年から、上場企業に対して国際的な枠組みに沿って気候関連リスクを投資家に開示するか、開示しない理由を説明するよう求めている。ＦＣＡがＦＴＳＥ３５０構成企業の２５年の年次報告書を調査したところ、９２％が気候関連リスクを開示していた。

ロンドン・スクール・オブ・エコノミクス（ＬＳＥ）のＴＰＩグローバル・クライメート・トランジション・センターのエグゼクティブディレクター、カルメン・ヌッツォ氏は、任意の開示が今後も高い水準を維持するかどうかや、開示データの比較が難しくなって気候リスクの評価に影響するかどうかは不透明だとの見方を示した。

その上で、上場企業の誘致を各市場が競う中では「他国・地域が先に規制を後退させると、規制上の競争力を重視する議論が勢いを増す傾向がある」と述べた。

item.title: Micron mit erneutem Rekordquartal und optimistischem Ausblick
item.description: Die anhaltend hohe Nachfrage nach Speicherchips hat Micron zu einem weiteren Rekordquartal verholfen. "Für das Geschäftsjahr 2026/2027 erwarten wir noch bessere Ergebnisse", sagte Sanjay Mehrotra, der Chef des Halbleiter-Herstellers, am Mittwoch. "Wir stocken unsere Investitionen in Technologie, Produkte und Fertigung auf."
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die anhaltend hohe Nachfrage nach Speicherchips hat Micron (MU.O) zu einem weiteren Rekordquartal verholfen. "Für das Geschäftsjahr 2026/2027 erwarten wir noch bessere Ergebnisse", sagte Sanjay Mehrotra, der Chef des Halbleiter-Herstellers, am Mittwoch. "Wir stocken unsere Investitionen in Technologie, Produkte und Fertigung auf." Das Unternehmen verfünffachte seinen Umsatz in den vergangenen drei Monaten auf 54,23 Milliarden Dollar. Der bereinigte Gewinn verelffachte sich auf 33,42 Dollar je Aktie. Für das angelaufene erste Quartal 2026/2027 stellte Micron Erlöse von 60 bis 63 Milliarden Dollar und einen Überschuss zwischen 37,15 und 39,15 Dollar je Aktie in Aussicht. Alle diese Kennzahlen lagen deutlich über den Markterwartungen. "Diese hervorragenden Geschäftszahlen und Prognosen dürften allen Zweiflern an der Nachhaltigkeit des KI-Ausbaus endgültig den Wind aus den Segeln nehmen", sagte Bob O’Donnell, Chefanalyst beim Research-Haus TECHnalysis. Micron-Aktien lagen im nachbörslichen Handel an der Wall Street ein knappes halbes Prozent im Plus. Sie haben ihren Wert binnen eines Jahres nahezu versechsfacht und damit die Papiere der südkoreanischen Konkurrenten Samsung (005930.KS) und SK Hynix (000660.KS) deutlich hinter sich gelassen. Die Speicherchip-Branche kann den rasant wachsenden Bedarf derzeit nicht decken. Daher haben sich die Preise für diese Halbleiter in den vergangenen Monaten vervielfacht. Micron rechnet für die kommenden Monate mit einer weiteren Verschärfung der Angebotsengpässe. Der US-Konzern will in den ersten sechs Monaten des Geschäftsjahres 2026/2027 rund 25 Milliarden Dollar in den Ausbau seiner Produktionskapazitäten investieren. Im zweiten Halbjahr dürften die Ausgaben höher ausfallen. Micron plant bis 2035 Gesamtinvestitionen von [USN:L8N43B16T TEXT:"250 Milliarden Dollar"]. Die weltweite Nummer drei der Branche konzentriert sich auf das [USN:L8N3XO07T TEXT:"margenstarke Geschäft"] mit Hochleistungsspeichern (HBM) für Künstliche Intelligenz (KI). Deshalb zieht sich das Unternehmen aus dem Massenmarkt mit Standardkomponenten für PCs oder Smartphones zurück.

item.title: Chinese refiners suspend October fuel exports, one cancels cargoes, sources say
item.description: Chinese refiners have suspended exports of oil products to regions beyond Hong Kong and Macau until further notice from Beijing, four people briefed on the matter said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Trixie Yap, Siyi Liu, Chen Aizhu
item.content:encoded: Chinese refiners have suspended exports of oil products to regions beyond Hong Kong and Macau until further notice from Beijing, four people briefed on the matter said on Thursday. As China looks to safeguard domestic supplies, state oil major PetroChina (601857.SS) cancelled on Wednesday a handful of its gasoline and jet fuel shipments that were planned for October, three of the sources said. It had committed to most of these now-cancelled deals in the past two weeks, the three sources added. The suspension of Chinese products exports will further constrain global markets that are grappling with the loss of supplies from the Middle East and [USN:L8N45M0AV TEXT:"Russia"] and could drive prices in some countries to [USN:L6N45K0Q8 TEXT:"new highs"]. China started its week-long holiday on Thursday without giving the green light to major refiners at the world's largest refining hub to export oil products to regions outside of Hong Kong and Macau. Another major refiner, privately controlled Zhejiang Petrochemical Corp (ZPC), skipped scheduling any oil product shipments during the holiday week, the fourth source said. PetroChina, ZPC and the National Development and Reform Commission did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment amid the holiday break. It is not clear if Beijing would resume permitting refiners' exports after the holiday ends on October 7, the sources said, adding that it could depend on domestic fuel inventories and refining output. Asian diesel refining margins rebounded to the highest in a week at around $75 a barrel, with the October-November price spreads trading at a two-week peak on concerns of tighter supplies. ,

item.title: Indonesia posts wider-than-expected $3.55 billion trade surplus in August
item.description: Indonesia booked a surprisingly large trade surplus of $3.55 billion in August, official data showed on Thursday, well above market expectations, but some economists doubted the position was sustainable.
item.dc:creator: Gayatri Suroyo, Bernadette Christina
item.content:encoded: Indonesia booked a surprisingly large trade surplus of $3.55 billion in August, official data showed on Thursday, well above market expectations, but some economists doubted the position was sustainable. The August surplus was the widest since September 2025, according to LSEG data, and significantly higher than the median forecast for a surplus of around $630 million in a [USN:L4N45L0TE TEXT:"Reuters poll"]. The large surplus could ease concerns about Indonesia's worsening current account position, after the country posted its biggest deficit since 2018 in the [USN:L1N44I02D TEXT:"April-June quarter"]. But Irman Faiz, an economist at Bank Danamon, said that while the surplus provided a near-term foreign exchange buffer, the improvement was "precarious rather than structural". Faiz attributed it to softer-than-expected imports that he said were temporary. "We therefore remain cautious on the external outlook, particularly as the terms-of-trade backdrop has become less favorable," he said. Danamon continues to expect the central bank to further tighten monetary policy to navigate external pressures, he said. IMPORT GROWTH WAS BELOW EXPECTATIONS Indonesia, the biggest economy in Southeast Asia, is the world's top exporter of thermal coal, palm oil and nickel and a major supplier of tin, copper, aluminium and coffee. The country has benefited from rising prices of some of its top commodity exports this year, with some gains driven by rising global crude prices due to the Middle East conflict. However, as a net oil importer, its import bills have also soared. Exports rose 6.72% on a yearly basis in August to reach $26.61 billion, according to Statistics Indonesia, compared with a 4.3% increase expected in the Reuters poll. The better-than-expected rise was driven by higher shipments of non-ferrous base metal products, nickel, aluminium, copper and base chemical products. Imports rose 19.09% on a yearly basis to $23.06 billion, below the 31.14% surge forecast in the poll. Resilient import growth is expected going forward, with improvement in the purchasing managers' index in September, while exports could face headwinds from soft demand, said Bank Permata economist Faisal Rachman. He forecast Indonesia's current account deficit to widen to 2.49% of GDP in 2026 and stay around that level in 2027, significantly wider than the 0.09% in [USN:L1N3ZG042 TEXT:"2025"], with the central bank seen keeping its tighter monetary policy stance. Bank Indonesia [USN:L6N45F0CU TEXT:"raised policy rates"] by 100 basis points between May and June to defend the falling rupiah currency .

item.title: 欧州決済企業、国境を越えた決済で協業 米国勢に対抗
item.description:
Jesús Aguado Elizabeth Howcroft Valentina Za
[マドリード／パリ／ミラノ ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州決済企業、国境を越えた決済で協業　米国勢に対抗 13:54 配信

写真は食料品のキャッシュレス決済端末。2020年4月、デュッセルドルフで撮影。REUTERS/Wolfgang Rattay

Jesús Aguado　Elizabeth Howcroft　Valentina Za

[マドリード／パリ／ミラノ ３０日 ロイター] - スペインの「ビズム」、イタリアの「バンコマット」、ブリュッセルに拠点を置く「Ｗｅｒｏ」を手がける欧州決済イニシアチブ（ＥＰＩ）などの欧州決済企業は３０日、各国の決済システムを相互接続する合弁会社の設立で国境を越えた決済で協業すると発表した。これらの企業の利用者数は欧州１３カ国の計約１億３０００万人に上り、欧州連合（ＥＵ）およびノルウェーの人口の７割超を占める。

欧州勢が結束することで、欧州の決済で大きなシェアを握っている米決済大手のビザやマスターカードに対抗するのが狙い。世界秩序が分断し、極めて重要な決済システムのアクセスに対する懸念が高まる中で、欧州の政策立案者らは地場企業が決済の主権を握ることを優先課題としてきた。

他に加わるのはＳＩＢＳ―ＭＢウェイ、ビップス・モバイルペイ。合弁会社の社名は「ユーロピアン・ネットワーク・フォー・ペイメンツ」（ＥＮＰ）で、拠点をスペイン・マドリードに置く。

協業により、欧州規格に基づく共通の技術・運用基盤と、口座間即時決済を通じて既存の決済システムが相互接続できるようになる。

また、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が２０２９年までに導入を計画している中央銀行デジタル通貨（ＣＢＤＣ）「デジタルユーロ」が、将来的に補完する可能性があると説明している。

ＥＰＩのマルティナ・バイマート最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、決済システムが断片化していることはかねてより欧州の決済スキームにとって「最大の障壁」だったと指摘した。

法律事務所メイヤー・ブラウンのパートナー、マルセル・ヘラウフ氏は「ＥＮＰの創設は、欧州の人々が既に利用している決済システムを置き換えるのではなく、それらを連携させることに重点が置かれていることを反映している」と言及。その上でＥＵの決済で事実上主権を握ることにつながるかどうかは、欧州の決済規制がどのように展開するかや、加盟店に受け入れられるかどうか、そしてＥＵ加盟国からの政治的支援が得られるかどうかにかかっているとの見解を示した。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ＥＵのＥＶ補助金巡る対中調査、自らに跳ね返るリスクも コラム：短距離フライト削減でＣＯ2対策なるか、的外れの欧州 焦点：トランプ政権の影で歩み寄るカナダとＥＵ、準加盟提示でも見える限界 焦点：コーヒー企業「アフリカ離れ」も、ＥＵが森林破壊防止法 アングル：長時間労働・残業に不満の中国労働者、ＥＵの対中圧力に「共感」 最終更新: 10/1(木) 13:54 ロイター

item.title: 米上院、議員の株取引制限法案進まず 民主が全面禁止要求
item.description:
Richard Cowan
[ワシントン ３０日] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Richard Cowan

[ワシントン ３０日] - 米上院は３０日、連邦議会議員の株取引に新たな制限を設ける法案の審議入り動議を否決した。民主党が法案は株取引の全面禁止に至らないと主張し、審議入りに必要な票が集まらなかった。

採決結果は賛成５３、反対４７で、手続き上のハードルをクリアするのに必要な６０票の賛成に届かなかった。共和党が推進する同法案は７月に下院を通過していた。

有権者は長年にわたり、議員による何千件もの株取引に憤りを示してきた。多くの人は、議員の特権的地位を踏まえると、こうした取引は不適切だと主張している。

法案は、連邦議会議員とその配偶者、扶養する子どもによる上場企業株の購入を禁止する内容。民主党は、既に保有している株式を持ち続けることや、配当金で株式を買い増すことなどを認めている点に反発した。

法案には、米国の選挙で投票する際に必要な写真付き身分証明書の要件を厳格化する共和党の条項も盛り込まれた。民主党はこれについて、投票資格のある市民が連邦選挙で投票するのを一層困難にするものだとし、「ポイズンピル（毒薬条項）」と非難した。

item.title: 中国、米国の貿易慣行巡る調査を延長 12月27日まで
item.description:
[北京 ３０日 ロイター] - 中国商務省は、３月に開始した米国の貿易慣行に関する２件の調査について、期限を３カ月延長し、１２月２７日までとすることを決めた。同省の声明で明らかになった。
• ９月２７日付の２件の声明によると、同省は事案の複雑さを踏まえて延長を決定した。
• 発表に先立つ数日前、米中は新たな貿易協議を開き、貿易休戦を２カ月延長して２０２７年１月１０日までとすることや、６００億ドル相当の製品の関税引き下げで合意していた。
• ２件の貿易障壁調査は３月２７日に開始され、「世界の供給網と産業網を混乱させる」米国の貿易慣行・措置と、「環境関連製品の貿易を妨げる」慣行・措置を対象としている。

• ９月２７日付の２件の声明によると、同省は事案の複雑さを踏まえて延長を決定した。

item.title: Geopolitical tensions, high crude may fuel India's imported inflation, says government report
item.description: Geopolitical tensions, high oil prices and tighter global financial conditions could raise India's imported inflation, a government report said on Thursday, while warning that a strong El Nino could hurt winter crops.
item.dc:creator: Manoj Kumar
item.content:encoded: Geopolitical tensions, high oil prices and tighter global financial conditions could raise India's imported inflation, a government report said on Thursday, while warning that a strong El Nino could hurt winter crops. India entered the second quarter of 2026/27 with strong domestic activity, exports, capital inflows and foreign exchange reserves, the finance ministry said in its September Monthly Economic Review. However, it cautioned that supply disruptions, volatile energy prices and global uncertainty could pose near-term risks to inflation, the rupee and capital flows. "Geopolitical tensions and elevated crude oil prices could also add to imported inflation pressures," the report said, particularly after the U.S. Federal Reserve's 25-basis-point rate hike in September. The report said the Reserve Bank of India's recent open market operations to absorb surplus liquidity could help maintain balanced financial conditions and curb "undue demand-side overheating." Festive demand and higher input costs could add to near-term price pressures, it said, but proactive government supply-side and market interventions could help contain upside risks and cushion temporary price shocks. [USN:L4N4560OU TEXT:"Retail inflation"] rose to 4.82% in August, while food inflation stood at 5.95%. Wholesale inflation accelerated to 9.92%, driven in part by renewed fuel and power price pressures. India's external sector remained resilient, supported by services exports, remittances, forex reserves and capital inflows, the report said. Foreign-exchange reserves stood at $765.9 billion as of Sept. 18, providing import cover of about 11.1 months. However, it said short-term pressure on Indian assets, including the rupee, persists amid unsettled U.S. trade relations, volatile portfolio flows and rising competition for global capital.

item.title: Gold firms as softer US inflation dims October Fed hike bets
item.description: Gold rose on Thursday after a softer-than-expected US inflation report tempered expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike this month, with markets looking to upcoming jobs data for further policy signals.
item.dc:creator: Ashitha Shivaprasad
item.content:encoded: Gold rose on Thursday after a softer-than-expected US inflation report tempered expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike this month, with markets looking to upcoming jobs data for further policy signals. Spot gold gained 0.8% to $4,187.43 per ounce by 0625 GMT, starting the month on a positive note after a more than 6% fall in September. US gold futures for December delivery firmed 0.7% to $4,217.50. [USN:L1N45M0L0 TEXT:"Data"] on Wednesday showed US inflation rose less than expected in August, while price pressures were revised lower for the prior month. The data reduced expectations of a rate hike in October, with markets pricing in a 36% chance, down from 45% before the release. Traders, however, still see an 89% probability of an increase in December. Higher interest rates reduce the appeal of gold, which does not pay interest. "Incoming data is going to be important... to see how the market deals with it and shapes rate-hike expectations," said Ilya Spivak, head of global macro at Tastylive. "We are in a situation where the market is dealing with a lot of conflicting forces." The crucial US nonfarm payrolls report for September is scheduled for release on Friday. Limiting gains for gold, the US dollar drifted higher. A stronger greenback makes dollar-priced metals costlier for holders of other currencies. All of gold's "September losses are unlikely to be recovered, but there are reasons to believe that the worst of the correction is over for now and that there is a case for higher prices," said Bart Melek, global head of commodity strategy at TD Securities. On the geopolitical front, [USN:L6N45M02H TEXT:"Iran"] said on Wednesday it had received a US response to its latest proposal to resurrect the collapsed ceasefire in the Gulf, days after US President Donald Trump said he had rejected it. Spot silver rose 1.4% to $61.23, platinum climbed 1.2% to $1,727.18 and palladium gained 0.6% to $1,210.75.

item.title: Indonesia arrests captain of capsized ferry, police say
item.description: An Indonesian police spokesperson said on Thursday that the captain of a ship that capsized in the Java Sea last month has been arrested and will face criminal charges for his role in an accident that killed at least 78 people.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: An Indonesian police spokesperson said on Thursday that the captain of a ship that capsized in the Java Sea last month has been arrested and will face criminal charges for his role in an accident that killed at least 78 people. The Virgo Transport 8 [USN:L1N45A08F TEXT:"ferry"] was carrying 243 people when it capsized in bad weather in the Java Sea on September 13 during a voyage from Surabaya in East Java to Banjarmasin in South Kalimantan. Authorities said 108 people survived. Divers have been circling the ship, [USN:L1N45A0AX TEXT:"battling"] against fast sea currents and the ship's unstable structure, to search for those missing on deck. National police spokesperson Trunoyudo Wisnu Andiko said that the ship's captain has been arrested and named a criminal suspect. Senior police official Kukuh Prabowo was quoted by state news agency Antara as saying on Wednesday that the captain was suspected of violating Indonesia's shipping law by knowingly sailing an unseaworthy vessel, an offence punishable by up to 10 years in prison when it causes deaths and property damage. Neither Wisnu nor Kukuh provided any details of the alleged crimes. The current death toll from the incident is 78 people, while 57 people remain missing, Indonesia's search and rescue agency said late on Wednesday. The search is ongoing.

item.title: ウクライナ、ロシアの独自衛星通信網巡り米に制裁要請 深刻な脅威と警告
item.description:
Andrea Shalal
[ワシントン ３０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Andrea Shalal

[ワシントン ３０日 ロイター] - ウクライナは、ロシアが米宇宙開発企業スペースＸの衛星通信サービス「スターリンク」に代わる国産の衛星通信網として開発を進める「ラスベット」を巡り、開発に協力しているとする複数のロシア企業などに制裁を科すよう米国に求めている。在米ウクライナ大使館のデニス・シエニク臨時代理大使が３０日、記者団に明らかにした。

シエニク氏は、ロシアはラスベットの衛星網を急速に拡大しており、２０２７年の運用開始を目指していると説明。２６年末までに衛星網が構築されれば「ウクライナ領内の標的をリアルタイムで攻撃できるようになる」と述べ、ウクライナにとって深刻な脅威になると警告した。

ウクライナ政府は、ラスベットの開発を支援しているとみなす企業や個人の詳細を米政府や議会に伝える方針で、ウクライナ独自の制裁も科す予定という。

シエニク氏は「これらの企業などが制裁対象にならなければ、ロシアによる計画の実現を可能にしてしまう。戦況を一変させる要因になる」と訴えた。

ラスベットを開発する「ＩＫＳホールディング」のアレクセイ・シェロブコフ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は６月、２７年にサービスを開始する計画を明らかにしていた。同社は３月に低軌道衛星１６基を初めて打ち上げ、数年間で９００基まで増やす計画だ。ロシアではスターリンクの利用が禁止され、関連機器の使用は罰金対象になる。

欧米諸国はこれまで、ロシアの宇宙通信能力を支えるインフラを制裁対象としてきたが、ウクライナ側は規制にはなお抜け穴があるとみており、米政府に制裁対象となるロシア企業や個人の拡大を求めている。

一方、ウクライナはロシア領内にある弾道ミサイル発射装置への攻撃を可能にするため、スターリンクの通信可能地域を拡大することも要請している。フィンランドのストゥブ大統領も先週、この動きを支持した。

冬を控えるウクライナでは、ロシアの弾道ミサイルを迎撃する防空能力が不足している。ウクライナ側は、ロシア領内でもウクライナ軍によるスターリンク利用が可能になれば、ミサイル発射装置を攻撃する能力の向上につながるとみている。

シエニク氏はまた、ウクライナ国内の米企業がロシア軍の攻撃を受けても、米政府が十分に反応していないと不満を表明した。同氏によると、ウクライナがカスピ海周辺の米国関連資産を攻撃した際には、米当局が強く抗議し、その後、両国間の連携強化や攻撃目標の精密化につながった。一方、ウクライナに進出する米企業がロシア軍の攻撃を受けた際には、米政府からロシアへの明確なメッセージはなく、被害を受けた企業名を公表することにも消極的だったという。

item.title: ＡＩエージェントがカナダ政府のサイトに侵入未遂＝研究機関
item.description:
Kanishka Singh Christian Martinez Deepa Seetharaman
[ワシントン ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＡＩエージェントがカナダ政府のサイトに侵入未遂＝研究機関 13:43 配信

写真は「AI（人工知能）」の文字とキーボード、ロボットの手のイメージ。9月23日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Kanishka Singh　Christian Martinez　Deepa Seetharaman

[ワシントン ３０日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）研究機関のトランスルースは３０日、ＡＩエージェントがカナダ政府のウェブサイトに侵入を試みたが、未遂に終わったと発表した。一方、カナダ政府は、自国のシステムが侵害された兆候はないとしている。

トランスルースは、今回の攻撃の手口が「オープンＡＩによるものと同機関が特定した、過去に観察されたエージェントの活動と一致している」と指摘したが、攻撃がオープンＡＩによるものと断定はできないとした。

トランスルースはブログ記事の中で、これらのエージェントが５月２８日と６月９日にカナダ国立図書館・公文書館へのアクセスを試みたと公表。先月２８日にこの件をカナダ政府に報告したと明らかにした。

カナダ・サイバーセキュリティーセンターは翌２９日、ＡＩエージェントによる活動が疑われるとの報告を把握しているが、現時点で、政府システムが侵害された兆候はないと声明で述べた。

オープンＡＩは「当社のモデルがカナダ政府のウェブサイトから公開されている情報へのアクセスを試みたという報告を把握している」と表明。広報担当者は、同社が報告された調査結果を精査しており、政府の調査を担当するカナダ当局者に対して最初の説明を行ったと語った。

トランスルースによると、ポルトガル科学技術財団が運営する無料のウェブアーカイブ「arquivo.pt」で、５月２８日と６月９日に、カナダ国立図書館・公文書館の「コレクション検索」サービスに対して行われた８９９件のリクエストを捕捉した。これには、失敗に終わったと思われる一連の初歩的なハッキングの試みも含まれていたという。

オーストラリア政府は先週、６月にオープンＡＩのＡＩエージェントが政府の医療データポータルに侵入し、ファイルへの不正アクセスを行ったと発表した。同社は２９日、このハッキングについて謝罪した。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず コラム：ＡＩで相互依存強める新興企業と巨大ＩＴ 最終更新: 10/1(木) 13:43 ロイター

item.title: 市場は「後手」リスク改めて意識、日銀主な意見で政府の利上げ慎重姿勢変化なく
item.description:
Noriyuki Hirata
[東京 １日 ロイター] - １日の東京市場では、朝方に日銀短観や９月会合の主な意見が...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
市場は「後手」リスク改めて意識、日銀主な意見で政府の利上げ慎重姿勢変化なく 13:41 配信

写真は日銀本店と日本国旗。2023年9月、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato

Noriyuki Hirata

[東京 １日 ロイター] - １日の東京市場では、朝方に日銀短観や９月会合の主な意見が発表されたことを受けて、長期や超長期金利上昇、円安、株高の反応となった。とりわけ市場では「主な意見」で、政府側出席者の利上げへのスタンスに関心が寄せられたが、特段の変化はないと受け止められた。日米首脳会談後に市場で高まっていた「容認」転換の思惑が後退し、日銀の早期利上げ織り込みも低下した。

短観や主な意見の発表を経て市場では「（日銀の政策が後手に回る）ビハインド・ザ・カーブの思惑を織り込みながら、円安や長期・超長期金利の上昇圧力になった可能性がある」（野村証券の宍戸知暁シニア金利ストラテジスト）との見方が聞かれた。

材料視されたのは「主な意見」で城内実経済財政相と目される「内閣府出席者」の発言に、これまでと特段の変化が確認されなかったことだ。

内閣府出席者は「今回の（利上げ）決定につき説明責任を果たすとともに、既往の利上げが累積的に与える影響について十分点検していただきたい」とした上で、「今後は、日本銀行が推計した中立金利も踏まえて検討していく必要があるのではないか」と踏み込んだ。

日銀の利上げ織り込みは、１０月米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での利上げ期待と連動している側面があり、前日に８月の米個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数の伸びが市場予想を下回ったことを受け、日本側の材料がなくても低下した可能性はある。ただ、日銀による１０月利上げの織り込みは午前９時半頃から低下し始めており、主な意見を織り込んだ可能性があると、野村の宍戸氏はみている。

為替市場でも「日銀の連続利上げ期待が後退し、ドル買い／円売りに傾いている」（ソニーフィナンシャルグループの石川久美子シニアアナリスト）との声が挙がった。ドルは朝方に１５７円前半を推移していたが、徐々に水準を切り上げ、午前の取引中盤には１５８円を回復した。

株式市場では、銀行や保険が業種別の下落率で上位となっており、早期利上げ期待の低下が影響したとの見方がある。

一方、日経平均は午前に２．４％上昇し、１カ月半ぶりに節目の６万８０００円を回復した。国内の人工知能（ＡＩ）・半導体関連株の上昇が日経平均高をけん引しており、米国でマイクロン・テクノロジーの好決算を好感した動きに加え、日銀短観の内容を受けて「上方修正期待を先読みし始めたのではないか」（大和証券の坪井裕豪チーフストラテジスト）との見方もあった。

短観について、企業業績面に着目し「全体でみると予想ほど強くなかったが、企業業績面では悪くなく堅調だったとみていいだろう」（坪井氏）との指摘が聞かれた。全規模全産業で今期の経常利益計画はプラス２．２％となり、前回のマイナス６．５％から急回復した。「年度末に向けて上昇していくパターンだが、前年同期はマイナス４．８％で保守的だったところ、早くもプラスに転換してきた」と坪井氏は指摘する。

＜市場の関心は再び米金融政策に、主な意見は「過去」の整理も＞

こうした消化が一巡すれば、市場の関心は今週末に発表を控える米雇用統計に向かうとみられる。ソニーＦＧの石川氏は「ドル主導の相場展開になるとみている。利上げを巡る思惑が交錯しやすくなり、米金利の先高観が意識されればさらにドル高が進むだろう」と話している。

主な意見で示された利上げに慎重な政府側の姿勢も「過去の資料として整理していいのではないか。今後の政府側の動きを見極めることが重要」（いちよしアセットマネジメントの秋野充成社長）との声もある。日銀会合を経て日米首脳会談があり、その後、「アベノミクス的な意味でのリフレ政策は終わっている」との城内経財相の発言が伝わった。

「ターミナルレート２．５％は織り込みすぎの感があるが、米国側の意向や円安リスクがくすぶる中で、目先は３カ月に１回の利上げは変わらないのではないか」といちよしＡＭの秋野氏は話している。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：日銀「中立金利超え」はあるか、利上げ継続判断を左右する2つの要因＝門間一夫氏 日銀が9月短観・利上げ決定会合「主な意見」を公表：識者はこうみる コラム：日米欧9月同時利上げ、浮き彫りになった「日銀の弱点」＝上野泰也氏 コラム：サービス価格上昇に加速の気配、日銀の緩和修正判断に影響も コラム：漸進的な日銀の緩和修正、ドル130円割れは短期間か＝植野大作氏 最終更新: 10/1(木) 14:33 ロイター

item.title: Colapinto takes full blame for Baku crash as he faces social media storm
item.description: Alpine's Franco Colapinto said that the days following his crash at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix had been among "the most difficult" of his career, as he faced questions and social media abuse following the collision that wiped out teammate Pierre Gasly and McLaren's Lando Norris.
item.dc:creator: Rohith Nair
item.content:encoded: Alpine's Franco Colapinto said that the days following his crash at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix had been among "the most difficult" of his career, as he faced questions and social media abuse following the collision that wiped out teammate Pierre Gasly and McLaren's Lando Norris. The incident occurred after a safety car restart in Baku, with Colapinto locking up at turn one before ploughing into French teammate Gasly in a crash that also collected reigning Formula One champion Norris. Norris initially called for Colapinto to be given a [USN:L6N45I05X TEXT:"one-race ban"] for triggering the crash, but later [USN:L6N45K0YZ TEXT:"apologised for the comments"] that he said he made in the heat of the moment. "There are some moments that are trickier than others, the most important is to grow from those and to improve as a driver and as a person," Colapinto told reporters on Thursday ahead of the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia. "So I think it's been one of those that you have to move on and learn from it. It also makes you stronger." The 23-year-old took full responsibility for the "silly mistake" which had "very big consequences," pointing out that both McLaren drivers Norris and Oscar Piastri also locked up at turn one during the race. "As soon as we made contact, I came back to (the paddock and took) full responsibility for it," he added. COLAPINTO 'SURPRISED' BY NORRIS' REACTION Colapinto revealed he was "a bit surprised" by Norris' initial comments calling for a race ban, noting that the McLaren driver had previously spoken out against online backlash. "I think he was in the heat at the moment," Colapinto said. "Of course, he knows what comments create, because he suffered from it or he was probably the driver that was speaking the most about hate just a few seasons ago." The crash sparked a wave of social media abuse, with Colapinto addressing criticism of his passionate Argentine fanbase while pointing out that hate comes "from all the world and from many other fan bases. "My message is sort of the same, that they sometimes don't realise what you can create by writing on your keyboard and that we are all humans," he said. "It's not easy for us when we get these kinds of things." Colapinto said he and Norris have since resolved their differences, with the Argentine saying they had chatted and "it's all good." He also praised Alpine team principal Flavio Briatore's handling of the situation, calling him "probably one of the best I've had in the sport," while dismissing speculation about his future with the team. "Those things never changed and now we're praying for the future," he said when asked if he had been threatened with being dropped. "I'm very grateful to be part of this team and with the support of everyone and Flavio from the start. Pierre, as my teammate, we have a very good relationship as well. Everything is good."

item.title: AI pressure, client caution cloud Indian IT earnings in September quarter
item.description: India's top IT companies are set to report another quarter of weak earnings and could trim their annual revenue growth forecasts, five brokerages said, as AI-driven pricing pressure and tepid spending by clients bite.
item.dc:creator: Bharath Rajeswaran, Haripriya Suresh
item.content:encoded: India's top IT companies are set to report another quarter of weak earnings and could trim their annual revenue growth forecasts, five brokerages said, as AI-driven [USN:L1N40R0IW TEXT:"pricing pressure"] and tepid spending by clients bite. The rise of AI-based technology has battered the $315-billion information technology sector, especially vulnerable because of its reliance on billable hours, forcing companies to rejig business models and offer steep discounts. The sector has been among the market's worst performers over the past year. "AI-led deflation has more legs to go and demand environment is not improving," Jefferies said in a note on Tuesday, citing additional pressure from higher oil prices and interest rates. India's top IT services company, Tata Consultancy Services (TCS.NS) , kicks off earnings on October 8, with peers Infosys (INFY.NS) , HCLTech (HCLT.NS) and Wipro (WIPR.NS) reporting later this month. IT companies typically post strong performance in the first two quarters of the fiscal year helped by higher billing days and project starts. However, first-quarter results were muted and expectations from the second are similarly subdued. The industry, which employs nearly 6 million in the world's most populous country, is expected to report its weakest sequential performance in three years for the July-September quarter, according to Jefferies, with revenue growth projected at 0.7% to 3.5% quarter-on-quarter for the top six firms. Year-on-year, analysts expect revenue to rise about 10% in rupee terms. While acquisitions and deal ramp-ups could boost performance for some large companies, organic revenue growth is expected to be weak. The country's largest IT firms are projected to report lacklustre growth, after stripping out currency fluctuations. The Nifty IT (.NIFTYIT) has dropped about 27% in 2026 so far, lagging the benchmark Nifty 50's (.NSEI) 13.4% drop. With demand conditions largely unchanged since the last quarter, investors will focus on annual revenue growth forecasts. Infosys is expected to trim the upper end of its 1.5% to 3% revenue growth forecast to 2.5%, analysts at Kotak said. Jefferies expects a sharper cut, to 0.5% to 2%. Brokerages expect HCLTech (HCLT.NS) and Tech Mahindra to lead among the larger companies, while Wipro (WIPR.NS) is likely to lag. Margins may improve modestly as rupee depreciation offsets some pricing pressure, though foreign exchange hedging losses could weigh on profit at Tech Mahindra, Coforge (COFO.NS) and Hexaware (HEXW.NS) .

item.title: 韓国大統領、北朝鮮に信頼回復と対話再開呼びかけ 国軍の日で演説
item.description: ［鶏竜（韓国） １日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［鶏竜（韓国）　１日　ロイター］ - 韓国の李在明大統領は、「国軍の日」の１日に演説を行い、北朝鮮に対し信頼回復に寄与し対話再開に応じるよう呼びかけた。両国は、非武装地帯（ＤＭＺ）で先月下旬に起きた地雷爆発を巡り互いに非難している。この爆発で韓国兵３人が負傷した。

李大統領は「長い断絶を経て、北側が今こそわれわれと共に信頼回復と対話再開の道に進むことを望む」と述べ、李政権として「南北間の軍事的緊張を緩和するための実質的な措置を一貫して追求する」と表明した。

自立した国防の取り組みの一環として、現在、米国が持つ戦時作戦統制権の韓国移管を目指す方針を改めて示した。

広範な国防改革の方針も示し、２０３０年代半ばまでの原子力潜水艦建造、人工知能（ＡＩ）を使った指揮統制システムや高エネルギーレーザー迎撃兵器を含むミサイル防衛能力強化を挙げた。この近代化の取り組みには、ＡＩ能力の拡充、将来の戦争に向けた軍の再編、ミサイルの脅威を探知・迎撃する「３軸体系」の強化も含まれるとした。

item.title: ＦＲＢの追加利上げ、12月に後ずれ ゴールドマンが予想修正
item.description: [１日 ロイター] - 米ゴールドマン・サックスは、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による次回利上げの予想時期を１２月に後...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＦＲＢの追加利上げ、12月に後ずれ　ゴールドマンが予想修正 13:36 配信

2012年4月3日、米ワシントンにあるFRBのビル。REUTERS/Joshua Roberts

[１日 ロイター] - 米ゴールドマン・サックスは、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による次回利上げの予想時期を１２月に後ずれさせた。市場予想を下回るインフレ指標を受け、ＦＲＢが１０月に再び利上げするとの観測が後退したことが背景。

従来は１０月に２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げを予想していた。

ゴールドマンは９月３０日付のリポートで「２回目の利上げ予想を１２月に先送りする。連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）が最終的に追加利上げは不要と判断する可能性は高いとみている」とした。

ＦＲＢはインフレ抑制に向け、９月に３年ぶりの利上げを実施した。ウォーシュ新議長の下で初の政策変更となった。

３０日発表の８月の米個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数は前年同月比３．４％上昇し、ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想の３．７％を下回った。

ニューヨーク連銀のウィリアムズ総裁は２９日、年内にあと１回の利上げが適切になる可能性があるとした上で、次回の利上げ時期を判断するためにＦＲＢには経済指標を見極める時間的余裕があるとの認識を示した。

ＣＭＥグループのフェドウオッチによると、金利先物市場が織り込む１０月の０．２５％ポイント利上げの確率は約３８％で、前営業日の約５１％、１週間前の約７１％から低下した。

市場参加者は、１０月２日に発表される９月の米雇用統計に注目している。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：日米欧9月同時利上げ、浮き彫りになった「日銀の弱点」＝上野泰也氏 コラム：何が豪ドルを動かしているのか＝高島修氏 コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 コラム：ドル／円の昨年高値更新に現実味、中立金利や介入効果に注目＝内田稔氏 コラム：9月ＦＯＭＣ、ドットプロット更新で金利見通しに波乱も 最終更新: 10/1(木) 13:36 ロイター

item.title: 米ドローン新興パワラス、海外軍事技術の米国への導入を計画
item.description:
Cassell Bryan-Low Ariba Shahid David Jeans
[３０日 ロイター] - トラン...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ドローン新興パワラス、海外軍事技術の米国への導入を計画 13:35 配信

Cassell Bryan-Low　Ariba Shahid　David Jeans

[３０日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領の長男ドナルド・トランプ・ジュニア氏と次男エリック・トランプ氏が支援する企業との合併を通じて上場する予定の米ドローン新興企業パワラス（Powerus）は、米国防総省の拡大する需要に応えるため、ウクライナなど海外で開発された技術を米国に導入することを目指している。同社幹部が明らかにした。

ロイターの取材で語ったところによると、同社は買収や海外企業との提携、米国内での製造を通じて事業を拡大する計画で、海外で開発された軍事技術を米国に導入し、国内生産するパートナー企業とすることを目指している。

ブレット・ベリコビッチ社長は、海外技術を「米国企業の顔」で提供することで、国防総省向けの「ワンストップソリューション」となることを目指していると述べた。ウクライナの防衛技術企業と協議しており、長距離攻撃ドローンなどの能力を加えたい考えだと説明した。

設立から１年のパワラスは１０月初旬、ナスダック上場のアウレウス・グリーンウェイ・ホールディングスとの合併を予定している。同社はゴルフコースの所有・運営会社で、トランプ兄弟が投資ファンドアメリカン・ベンチャーズを通じて間接的に出資している。規制当局への提出書類によると、合併後の新会社ではアメリカン・ベンチャーズが９．９％の所有権を持つ見通し。

トランプ兄弟はイスラエルのＸＴＥＮＤ（エクステンド）ＡＩロボティックスなど複数のドローン・軍事技術企業に出資しており、フロリダ州に拠点を置くパワラスもこうした企業の１つ。エクステンドは９月初旬、上場建設会社との合併によって上場を果たしたが、この建設会社にはアメリカン・ベンチャーズも出資していた。

パワラスの幹部とトランプ・ジュニア氏、エリック氏の広報担当者によると、トランプ兄弟はアウレウスへの出資で受動的な投資家であり、パワラスの運営には関与していない。

一方、パワラスの事業は依然として初期段階にあり、２０２６年初めの時点では収益を生む事業を行っていなかった。今年初めに買収を通じて航空・海上ドローンの製品群をそろえ、１－３月期の売上高は１２０万ドルとなった。ベリコビッチ氏によると、３月に公開した「ガーディアン」迎撃ドローンはウクライナ側との「共同開発」の成果だという。

パワラスは最近、最大９０００万ドル相当の米空軍との契約と、詳細が明らかにされていない顧客向けに中東のエネルギーインフラを防護するための２２３０万ドルの民間向け契約を獲得したと発表した。同社は湾岸諸国とも協議しているという。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：米移民摘発、過去最高の逮捕件数も送還難航　法的手続きや移送能力に壁 コラム：米財務省の借入拡大、債務問題の大きさに比べれば単なるノイズ 焦点：テスラ、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」で試す規制の限界 コラム：日銀利上げの「美しいシナリオ」に弱点はないか＝上野泰也氏 コラム：日米協調介入が告げる円高への転換、円安派は今こそ見直しの時 最終更新: 10/1(木) 13:35 ロイター

item.title: Taiwan plans $13 billion in extra energy spending given high global prices
item.description: Taiwan's government said on Thursday that it plans to spend around T$415 billion ($13.0 billion) this year to help its main power producer Taipower and oil refiner CPC absorb costs from sharply rising global energy prices due to the Middle East war.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Taiwan's government said on Thursday that it plans to spend around T$415 billion ($13.0 billion) this year to help its main power producer Taipower and oil refiner CPC absorb costs from sharply rising global energy prices due to the Middle East war. Taiwan has not passed on most of the rising costs to consumers, unlike in other parts of the world, and it heavily subsidises energy bills, helping to keep inflation down. In a statement following a weekly cabinet meeting, the economy ministry said that budget estimates made last year were inadequate due to the Middle East "turmoil" affecting energy prices this year. The ministry said it had proposed a T$180.9 billion supplementary budget for Taipower, CPC and other energy producers to "absorb price differentials" this year, with an additional capital injection of T$233.8 billion for CPC to improve its financial structure. State-owned CPC in particular "cannot absorb the difference between adjusted and non-adjusted oil and gas prices" and its accumulated losses will exceed T$127.6 billion, making borrowing difficult, the ministry said. That could lead to CPC's international credit rating being downgraded and a sharp reduction in procurement negotiating power, it said. "Without supplementary budgets, both CPC and Taipower may struggle to continue serving as price stabilisers, causing price volatility," said the economy ministry, which is in charge of energy policy. The ministry also called for Taiwan's parliament to support the spending plans, saying maintaining price stability and ensuring stable natural gas supply are matters of "utmost urgency". ($1 = 31.9520 Taiwan dollars)

item.title: Gambhir rues batting-friendly pitches after India's record ODI chase
item.description: Oct 1 : India coach Gautam Gambhir said the batting-friendly pitch in Guwahati was unfair on bowlers after his side completed the second-highest successful chase in one-day international history on Wednesday.India overhauled West Indies' 405-7 with an eight-wicket victory to seal the series, but Gambhir said

item.content:encoded:

Gambhir rues batting-friendly pitches after India's record ODI chase

FAST

Oct 1 : India coach Gautam Gambhir said the batting-friendly pitch in Guwahati was unfair on bowlers after his side completed the second-highest successful chase in one-day international history on Wednesday. India overhauled West Indies' 405-7 with an eight-wicket victory to seal the series, but Gambhir said the run-fest underlined the need for a fairer contest between bat and ball. "There has to be a bit more of a contest between bat and ball, because I think you talk about cricket — but this is not cricket, this is only batting," Gambhir told Star Sports. "Imagine a young bowler bowling on this wicket, and the opposition getting 400 and then we go on to chase 400.

"For the records it's outstanding, for the crowd it's outstanding, for the broadcaster it's outstanding, but as a genuine cricket fan and as a coach, I have to have sympathy for the bowlers as well." The 44-year-old said bowlers should not be judged solely by their figures on surfaces that provide virtually no assistance. "When you bowl on this kind of a wicket, it's not fair for the bowlers. So we've got to give something to the bowlers so there's at least something which the bowlers can work with," he said. "You can't be hard on bowlers, because sometimes bowling figures are such that they haven't bowled as poorly as their figures suggest." Gambhir added that bowlers already operate under pressure in modern ODI cricket because of fielding restrictions, two new balls and increasingly aggressive batting, making balanced surfaces even more important. Looking ahead to next year's 50-over World Cup, Gambhir said India had limited time to settle on their combinations, with the Indian Premier League and bilateral commitments reducing the window for experimentation. "Right now is the time for us to try different options," he said. "Just like Auqib (Nabi) got an opportunity, we will similarly try, at least until the Zimbabwe series, to give other people an opportunity and see what they can offer us in this format." India lead the three-match series 2-0, with the final ODI scheduled for New Chandigarh on Saturday.

Source: Reuters

item.content:encoded: Follow on Apple or Spotify . Listen on the Reuters app. The $160 bln Swiss banking giant is facing an enormous capital bill following its rescue of Credit Suisse. In this Viewsroom podcast, Breakingviews columnists debate whether the government is right to demand higher regulatory buffers and how the lender might actually leave home. (The hosts are Reuters Breakingviews columnists. The opinions expressed are their own.) item.title: 韓国・釜山で水路に迷い込んだサメが話題、2週間で約60万人が見物
item.description:
韓国南部・釜山の水路に迷い込んだサメが、同国で話題となっている。釜山市によると、過去2週間で約60万人がこのサメを一目見ようと詰めかけたという。
体長3.5メートルのこのサメは、9月18日に初めて確認された。
聯合ニューステレビが公開した映像によると、海洋警察など関係機関が船を出し、サメの後方から放水してゆっくりと外洋に向かわせようとしたが失敗に終わった。
朝鮮日報によると、当局は10月2日に網を使ってサメを水路の外へ誘導する計画だ。
